Title: Developer (m/f/d) - Investment Solutions
Description:
Job Purpose/role

Das Team AIM Life/Health Germany in Stuttgart entwickelt und implementiert die Anlagestrategie für die deutschen Lebens- und Krankenversicherungsgesellschaften der Allianz. Als Teil des Digital Solution Teams erfolgt eine aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung der quantitativen Portfolioanalyse-Plattform. Eingebettet in eine interdisziplinäre Investment-Abteilung werden Cloud-Anwendungen entlang der gesamten Investment-Wertschöpfungskette konzipiert und implementiert. Die Position bietet die Möglichkeit, Expertise in den Bereichen Advanced Analytics, Informatik und moderne Technologien für die wirksame und effiziente Steuerung von Portfolios mit einem Gesamtvolumen von über 300 Milliarden Euro einzusetzen.

Key Responsibilities


Konzeption und Entwicklung von Anwendungen für die Portfoliosteuerung
Entwicklung innovativer Datenlösungen zur Erweiterung analytischer Fähigkeiten
Einsatz von Data-Analytics-Methoden zur Beantwortung komplexer, datengetriebener Fragestellungen rund um das Anlageportfolio
Präsentation von Projekten vor dem AIM-Management

Title: Sustainability Data Analyst (f-m-d)
Description:
Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools, outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial, construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement, repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® - recognized worldwide for their deep heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality.

The company maintains a global manufacturing and product development footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2 billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth.

Key Responsibilities:


Collaborate with business stakeholders and leadership to gather requirements, develop, and support data modelling and BI solutions for organizational stakeholders
Integrate different data sources into a cohesive data fabric, ensuring data consistency, accuracy and reliability
Conduct business analysis activities to understand business user requirements and translate data and information flows within business processes
Analyze sustainability, quality & regulatory data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement
Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to support informed decision-making in sustainability initiatives
Perform data profiling, validation and cleaning to ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality of enterprise data
Maintain data quality standards and enforce data governance policies, standards and best practices
Maintain clear documentation for data orchestrations, highlighting their value and contribution to improved data modeling and governance


Requirements:


Bachelor's or similar degree in Data Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
Proven experience with Power BI, Power Automate, VBA, C++ programming, Python, and SAP QuickViewer
Good communication skills in German and English, both written and spoken
Knowledge of Qlik Sense and IBM Envizi is considered an advantage
Relevant experience in data analysis, reporting, and data visualization

If you're looking to join a forward-thinking company that values collaboration, innovation, and impact — we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and be part of something exciting!

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
About Us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

The Role

As an ML Engineer within the Application Engineering team, you’ll lead critical initiatives that push the frontier of model-based autonomous driving—both in terms of core driving performance and feature-level intelligence such as personalisation, comfort, and collaboration.

You’ll design and deliver ML-driven behaviors that scale from assisted to autonomous driving. Your work will span across model architecture, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and real-world deployment. You’ll collaborate deeply with AI Platform, Simulation, Robot SW and Model Release teams to build systems that are performant, adaptable, and ready for production.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and improve end-to-end driving models with state-of-the-art performance, robustness, and generalization.
Lead projects on personalized and collaborative driving, including behavior conditioning, comfort tuning, and user alignment.
Build evaluation pipelines and metrics for both closed-loop and open-loop driving performance and product readiness.
Curate and mine real-world and synthetic data to drive scenario diversity, coverage, and feature-specific development.
Influence architecture choices, training methodologies, and deployment pathways for production-scale learning systems.
Collaborate cross-functionally across various teams to ensure integration and iteration velocity.
Mentor senior engineers and shape the long-term technical direction across Autonomy.


About You

In order to set you up for success as a Machine Learning Engineer at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential


Extensive and proven track record of shipping deep learning systems to production.
Expert in deep learning (esp. sequential models, control, planning, or perception).
Proficient in Python and other relevant languages (e.g. C++ and CUDA) and ML frameworks (esp. PyTorch), with a solid foundation in software engineering practices.
Experience with real-time systems or robotics, ideally with simulation- or vehicle-in-the-loop components.
Ability to lead technical initiatives across teams, drive alignment, and mentor engineers.


Desirable


Prior work in autonomous driving, imitation learning, or trajectory prediction.
Familiarity with personalization, human behavior modeling, or driver intent inference.
Experience integrating ML systems into production hardware or multi-agent simulation.


This is a full-time role based in our office in Leonberg. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. We operate core working hours so you can determine the schedule that works best for you and your team.

Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in our interview process, please let us know.

We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve.

To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

For US candidates only, please visit E-Verify Notice and Participation and Right to Work

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Title: AI & Automation Developer SAP (all genders)
Description:
DEINE ROLLE


Von der Idee zum Code: Als AI & Automation Developer setzt du KI-Lösungen hands-on um – von der ersten Prototyp-Zeile bis zum produktiven Deployment in komplexen SAP-Landschaften.
Joule & SAP Build im Einsatz: Du entwickelst Custom Joule Skills und Agents in Joule Studio und SAP Build und bindest dabei SAP-Backend-Systeme sowie externe Services an.
Agenten-Ökosystem erweitern: MCP-Server konzipierst und implementierst du eigenständig oder im Team und baust darauf aufsetzende RAG-Pipelines (Chunking, Embeddings, Vektordatenbank-Integration, kontextbezogene Antwortgenerierung).
KI-Services produktiv machen: Du entwickelst und deployst KI-Services auf SAP AI Core und SAP AI Launchpad und integrierst externe KI-Plattformen wie Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI oder Anthropic.
Automatisierung realisieren: Technische Umsetzung von Automatisierungen mit SAP Build Process Automation, Power Automate, n8n oder vergleichbaren Plattformen gehört zu deinem Tagesgeschäft.
Schnell testen, schnell lernen: Durch Prototypen und MVPs validierst du KI-Use-Cases frühzeitig und teilst dein Wissen aktiv im Team.


DEIN PROFIL


Qualifikation: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Computer Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet deine Basis.
Entwicklungserfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Fokus auf KI, ML oder Automatisierung mit – idealerweise in Python und/oder JavaScript/TypeScript.
Cloud- & SAP-Affinität: Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit SAP BTP – idealerweise in den Bereichen Cloud Foundry, Kyma, SAP CAP oder SAP Build. Zusätzliche Kenntnisse in Cloud-Technologien wie Azure, GCP oder AWS sind von Vorteil.
KI in der Tiefe verstehen: LLM, GenAI, GPT-/Transformer-Architektur, RAG, Tokenisierung, Embeddings, MCP und Knowledge Graphs kannst du nicht nur erklären, sondern in produktiven Code übersetzen.
Framework-Know-how: Mit KI-Frameworks wie LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel oder Hugging Face hast du idealerweise bereits praktisch gearbeitet – gerne auch in eigenen Side-Projects oder Open-Source-Beiträgen. Erfahrung mit Vektordatenbanken (z. B. SAP HANA Vector Engine, Pinecone, Chroma) ist ein Plus.
Kommunikationstalent: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, intern sowie extern.


Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Title: AI Engineer (w/m/d)
Description:
Werde Teil der LGI Logistics Group International. Mit unserer Unternehmensgruppe sind wir nicht nur einer der führenden industriellen Kontraktlogistiker in Deutschland. Wir sind auch Transportexperte und Innovationstreiber. Mit zukunftsweisenden Logistiklösungen leisten wir den entscheidenden Mehrwert für renommierte Kunden. Ob Automotive, Electronics, Textillogistik, Healthcare oder Industrielogistik – wir haben's auf Lager und liefern ab. An über 45 Standorten weltweit arbeiten wir mit rund 5.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen an unseren gemeinsamen Zielen. Und wir kommen ihnen jeden Tag ein Stück näher.

Komm zu uns als:

AI Engineer (w/m/d)
Böblingen, deutschlandweit
Aufgaben
In der Logistik ist immer was los. Da ist Action angesagt. Aber auch Feingefühl. Anpacken. Aber mit Köpfchen. Ein Rad greift ins andere. Alles fließt. Und doch bist du bei uns alles andere als ein Rädchen im Getriebe. Hier kannst du wirklich was bewegen. Ist doch logistisch! Aber überzeug dich selbst:
Mit deinem Know-how entwickelst du innovative KI-Anwendungen auf unserer zentralen AI-Plattform und begleitest deren Einführung bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören die Konzeption, Entwicklung und Optimierung von RAG-Lösungen sowie die Sicherstellung einer hohen Antwortqualität durch geeignete Retrieval-Strategien.
Du integrierst Large Language Models (LLMs) über APIs und setzt moderne Konzepte wie Context Handling, Tool Calling und strukturierte Outputs um.
Die Entwicklung von Datenprodukten und Services sowie deren Bereitstellung über MCP-Server für verschiedene AI-Anwendungen liegen in deinem Verantwortungsbereich.
Die Evaluation, Qualitätssicherung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von KI-Lösungen gehören zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich.
Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen analysierst du Anforderungen, entwickelst Prototypen und überführst erfolgreiche Konzepte in skalierbare Lösungen.
Du arbeitest eng mit dem AI Platform Engineer zusammen und entwickelst wiederverwendbare Komponenten sowie technische Standards.
Durch die kontinuierliche Beobachtung neuer Entwicklungen im Bereich Generative AI bewertest du deren Potenzial für das Unternehmen und bringst innovative Ideen aktiv ein.


Profil

Mit deiner fundierten Erfahrung in der Python-Entwicklung realisierst du moderne Softwarelösungen nach professionellen Entwicklungsstandards.
Zu deinem Know-how zählen Large Language Models (LLMs), deren API-Anbindung sowie Context Handling, Tool Calling und Prompt Engineering.
Im Aufbau von RAG-Lösungen bringst du fundierte Kenntnisse mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen Embeddings, Chunking, Vector Search und Retrieval-Optimierung.
Du besitzt Erfahrung in der Verarbeitung und Modellierung von Daten sowie im Umgang mit SQL, APIs und unstrukturierten Dokumenten.
Zusätzlich kannst du bei uns punkten, wenn du Erfahrung mit Databricks (z. B. Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL oder Vector Search) sowie der Entwicklung moderner Datenplattformen mitbringst.
Idealerweise hast du sogar bereits mit Agenten-Frameworks wie LangGraph oder Semantic Kernel gearbeitet und kennst Konzepte wie MCP (Model Context Protocol), automatisierte Evaluierungen oder AI-Agenten-Architekturen.
Mit deiner analytischen und lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise arbeitest du eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und bewegst dich souverän im Austausch mit Fachbereichen.

Wir bieten
Wir sind bestrebt danach, eine positive Arbeitsumgebung zu schaffen, um die beruflichen Ziele unserer Mitarbeiter*innen zu verwirklichen. Unsere Mitarbeiter*innen sind uns wichtig, denn ihnen verdankt LGI den großen Erfolg. Ein ehrlicher, fairer und respektvoller Umgang ist da für uns nur selbstverständlich – übrigens den Menschen genauso wie der Umwelt gegenüber.

Worauf du dich außerdem freuen kannst:
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 95 % mobiles Arbeiten und Workation: Genieße eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und die Möglichkeit, mobil und im EU-Ausland zu arbeiten
JobRad-Leasing: Leihe dir problemlos und kostengünstig ein JobRad über Gehaltsumwandlung
Innovative Unternehmenskultur: Arbeite in einem Umfeld mit Innovationskraft, Engagement und Teamgeist, flachen Hierarchien und offener Kommunikation
Weiterbildung: Fördere deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung in unserem Logistik-Lernzentrum
Attraktive Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von tollen Angeboten und Vergünstigungen für dein Privatleben
Erholung inklusive: Freue dich auf 30 Urlaubstage on top

Important note
Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered.

Title: Air and Missile Defense Data Visualization Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0246839

Air and Missile Defense Data Visualization Analyst

The Opportunity:

As a client-facing Data Visualization Analyst on our team, you’ll work closely with our Integrated Air and Missile defense customers across the joint force, planners, analysts, and mission partners to understand their questions and needs, then dig into data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deeper understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise the client on what the information means and how it can be used to improve planning, assessment, partner engagement, and senior leader decision-making. Through gaining efficiency and accuracy, this position will enable leaders within the Joint Integrated Air and Missile Defense community better understand and display trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities across U.S., Allied, partner nation programs and operational activities.

How You’ll Contribute:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships with respect to Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD).
Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, cleaning, interpretation, evaluation, integration, and analysis of operational and assessment data.
Contribute to impactful work and guide rapid decision-making across IAMD planners, assessment analysts, operational environment analysts, and senior stakeholders.
Collaborate with Service components to institute common operational pictures to provide real-time data-driven information to enable customers to make rapid assessments and accelerate decision-making cycles.
Apply communication skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements, data trends, and analytical findings based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, Maven, scripting languages such as SQL, Python, or R, visualization tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Apply data visualization through formats including, but not limited to Maven, dashboards, graphs, tables, trackers, maps, and PowerPoint.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions across the Integrated Air and Missile defense enterprise in the US European Command Area of responsibility through campaign assessments, Allied and partner nation engagements, and operational planning missions.



Work with us to drive large-scale decisions through data insights, specializing in IAMD information.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have: 


3+ years of experience in application development, AI and ML engineering, software engineering, or data science
3+ years of experience designing, developing, operationalizing, and maintaining complex software or machine learning applications at enterprise scale
1+ years of experience creating software for retrieving, parsing, and processing structured and unstructured data to support machine learning workflows
1+ years of experience with building scalable data pipelines, ETL and ELT workflows, or model training and deployment pipelines
Experience creating solutions within a collaborative and cross-functional team environment
Ability to code and develop scalable solutions from scratch using languages such as Python or TypeScript
Ability to navigate ambiguity, problem-solve creatively, and operate with minimal supervision
Ability to develop scripts and programs for converting various types of data into usable formats and support project teams to scale, monitor, and operate AI/ML platforms
TS/SCI clearance
Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience in a professional work environment, or 7+ years of experience in a professional work environment in lieu of a degree



Nice If You Have: 


Experience with Palantir tools, such as Foundry
Experience with Full-Stack application development for deploying ML models
Experience with distributed data or computing tools, including Databricks
Experience working on real-time data, streaming applications, or AI model deployment
Knowledge of U.S. Joint Force Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD) or Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD) combat systems, data architectures, Command and Control, and IAMD information concepts



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

Title: Information Operations Data Engineer
Description:
Job Number: R0247973

Information Operations Data Engineer

The Opportunity:

In today’s operational environment, mission owners rely on timely, trustworthy, and scalable data capabilities to plan, decide, and act. As a forward‑deployed Data Engineer, you will partner directly with end users to help them build, operate, and maintain high performance, scalable, and reliable data solutions that meet evolving mission demands. You won’t just write code, you will own the full lifecycle of data and AI solution delivery, from requirements discovery and synthesis to development, test and evaluation, deployment, training, sustainment, and eventual sunsetting.

You will guide customers through emerging technologies, helping them understand what is possible while rapidly engineering solutions tailored to their workflows. You’ll support multiple concurrent projects, switching seamlessly between full‑stack development, data science, data engineering, modeling and simulation, and agentic AI workflows, always selecting the right tool for the right problem. You will continually explore and integrate new services, platforms, and capabilities within the customer’s ecosystem to ensure long‑term mission resilience.

If you thrive in fast‑paced, ambiguous, highly collaborative environments and enjoy working directly with mission users to co‑create operational tools, this role is your opportunity to drive impact at the source of the mission.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:  


5+ years of experience with application development and full‑stack engineering in production environments
5+ years of experience developing, operationalizing, and maintaining complex, enterprise-scale data applications, architectures, and pipelines, such as Palantir, including Foundry, AIP, or Gotham, and War Data Platform, such as Advana
5+ years of experience building ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformation workflows, and solutions for structured and unstructured data processing at scale
3+ years of experience working directly with senior mission stakeholders, translating requirements and communicating dense technical information clearly to non‑technical and technical audiences
3+ years of experience working embedded with end users
2+ years of experience building and deploying agentic AI workflows, autonomous data pipelines, and modeling and simulation systems into production, including designing and implementing multi‑agent orchestration on top of existing LLM platforms
Experience supporting the full lifecycle of technical product development, including requirements gathering, decomposition, synthesis, development, testing, deployment, training, sustainment, and decommissioning and migration
Ability to rapidly learn new platforms and navigate tool ecosystems and remaining platform agnostic
TS/SCI clearance
Bachelor’s degree



Nice If You Have:  


Experience with Python, SQL, Scala, or Java
Experience working with Department of War customers
Experience working at a Combatant Command or in an international environment
Experience with geospatial data
Experience with military exercises
Experience with distributed data or computing tools, including Spark, Databricks, Hadoop, Hive, AWS EMR, or Kafka
Experience working on real-time data and streaming applications 
Experience with synthetic or bootstrapped data method
Experience with Agile engineering practices



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required. 

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,500.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.



Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Programmierkenntnisse in mindestens einer populären Programmiersprache (z.B. C++, C#, Java, Python, Julia, R, Matlab)
Interesse an finanzmathematischen, technischen und wirtschaftlichen Themen, z.B. stochastische Modellierung, Zeitreihenanalyse, Monte-Carlo-Simulation

Title: Data Visualization Engineer & Data Integration Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0242934

Data Visualization Engineer & Data Integration Analyst

The Opportunity:

As a data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data available across operational, assessment, and planning environments, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve mission challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a national security mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to help U.S. Special Operations leaders better understand trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities across partner nation programs and operational activities.

As a client-facing Data Visualization Engineer & Data Integration Analyst on our team, you’ll work closely with Special Operations customers, planners, analysts, and mission partners to understand their questions and needs, then dig into data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deeper understanding of their data, you’ll also advise the client on what the information means and how it can be used to improve planning, assessment, partner engagement, and senior leader decision-making.

Title: Data Scientist - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with clients and interdisciplinary teams to develop impactful analytics solutions, optimize code, and solve real-world business problems across diverse industries.

You’ll grow as a technologist by contributing to cutting-edge projects, R&D, and global conferences while working alongside world-class talent in a dynamic, innovative environment.

In this role, you will partner with clients to understand their needs and develop impactful analytics solutions. You will translate business problems into analytical challenges, build models to solve them, and ensure they are evaluated with relevant metrics. You’ll also contribute to internal tools, participate in R&D projects, and have opportunities to attend and present at conferences like NIPS and ICML.

Your work will create real-world impact. By identifying patterns in data and delivering innovative solutions, you will help clients maintain their competitive advantage and transform their day-to-day operations. Your contributions will directly influence business outcomes and drive lasting improvements across industries.

You will be in Stockholm, and collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, designers, and product managers around the world working on interdisciplinary projects that use math, statistics, and machine learning to derive insights from raw data. You will help global companies transform their businesses and enhance performance across industries such as healthcare, automotive, energy, and elite sports.

At McKinsey, you’ll thrive in an unparalleled environment for growth. You’ll develop a sought-after perspective by connecting technology and business value, tackle real-life challenges across diverse industries, and collaborate with inspiring multidisciplinary teams, gaining a holistic understanding of AI and its potential to drive transformation.

While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, we often leverage the following technologies: Python, PySpark, the PyData stack, SQL, Airflow, Databricks, our own open-source data pipelining framework called Kedro, Dask/RAPIDS, container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, cloud solutions such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, and more.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelors, Masters or PhD level in a discipline such as: computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering or artificial intelligence
Professional experience in applying machine learning and data mining techniques to real problems with copious amounts of data
Programming experience (focus on machine learning): R and/or Python (must), SPSS, SAS, Ruby, Hadoop (valued)
Ability to prototype statistical analysis and modeling algorithms and apply these algorithms for data driven solutions to problems in new domains
Ability to independently own and drive model development, balancing demands and deadlines
Demonstrated aptitude for analytics
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
Good presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to people from other fields
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels
Willingness to travel

Title: Senior Data Scientist to Handelsbanken
Description:
Join the AI & Automation team at Handelsbanken as we help the bank make smarter, data‑driven decisions and deliver the best possible experience for customers and employees.

About The Team

We’re on a mission to lead the industry in advanced analytics and AI, delivering smarter products, services, and experiences for our customers. Our cross-functional team, consisting of Data Scientist, Data and Platform Engineers and a Product Manager, combines deep technical expertise with a passion for innovation. Together, we design scalable solutions that use statistics, machine learning, and GenAI to solve real business challenges across the bank.

Your role

As a Senior Data Scientist, you’ll work hands-on with data, models, and analyses across the bank. You´ll develop, apply, and improve data science and machine learning models. You´ll explore analytical approaches to business challenges and evaluate what will create the most value. You´ll work across the entire data science lifecycle, from idea and exploration to deployment and evaluation. You´ll collaborate closely with your colleagues to understand business challenges, explore analytical approaches, and help implement effective solutions. You’ll play an important role in communicate insights clearly and effectively, ensuring decisions are grounded in data.

In this role, you’ll have the freedom to explore new analytical questions, the support of experienced colleagues, and opportunities to experiment with new tools, methods, and techniques.

Your profile

You hold a Master’s degree, PhD, or similar experience in a quantitative field and have experience working as a Data Scientist, preferably in banking or finance. You have strong problem-solving skills and enjoy working with data to understand complex questions and develop analytical solutions. You also have strong skills in Python and SQL for analysis, modelling, and production workflows.

For this role, we believe you have:


Applied knowledge of statistics and mathematics, ideally with a focus on machine learning.
Experience communicating technical concepts to non‑technical audiences.
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into analytical solutions.
Experience with large language models or retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) is a plus.
Swedish language skills — or a willingness to learn.


As a person, you’re curious and inventive, continuously striving to learn and improve. You stay up to date with new developments and explore new technologies and best practices. You share our commitment to being smart, humble, and collaborative. We offer a stable, value‑driven workplace with long‑term thinking, trust, and autonomy at its core.

What we offer:


Occupational pension
Profit-sharing scheme

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Northmill Bank is a challenger bank at the intersection of technology and finance, committed to revolutionizing the way people manage and protect their financial well-being. We are creating a different kind of banking experience, digital yet personal.




Northmill Bank was founded in 2006 and have grown to over 240 employees in 3 countries and over 270 000 customers. We use the latest technology to develop safe, smart, and user-friendly products for our customers. They are the sole reason why we do what we do. We are a 100% cloud-based product company where technology is the driver to create smarter banking products.




Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!




About our tech stack:

Dagster
Snowflake
DBT
Amazon Quick
AWS (Lambda, S3, ECR)




About the role

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our dynamic and cross-functional team. As a Senior Data Scientist at Northmill, you will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, fellow Data Scientists, Analysts, and key business stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities and leverage data-driven insights that will drive our business forward. Your primary focus will be on leading data science initiatives across various areas of the bank.




In this holistic role, you will be a part of the entire model lifecycle, from data collection and preparation to implementation. You will work closely with Data Engineers to ensure the availability of high-quality data, as well as with Analysts and business leaders to ensure that your models are effectively applied and communicated across the business. Your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of our fintech bank, and your work will have a direct impact on our success.




Responsibilities:

Take proactive ownership of the entire model lifecycle, from data collection, through modeling and analysis, to model deployment and implementation.
Work closely with Data Engineers to acquire and transform data.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and advise stakeholders to proactively anticipate business needs and translate them into data science solutions.
Create and present actionable insights and data visualizations that drive decision-making processes across the bank.
Continuously monitor and optimize models to proactively drive model refinement and communicate performance findings to stakeholders.
Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in data science, proactively proposing new initiatives where applicable.




Qualifications

The ideal fit should have experience in statistical modeling and machine learning, from the financial sector, combined with strong problem-solving skills, analytical abilities, excellent stakeholder communication, and a prestigeless, collaborative spirit. We value individuals who are passionate about utilizing data to solve practical challenges and drive business outcomes.




Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field. (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics)
+5 years of experience in data science or related roles.
Proficiency in SQL/Snowflake for data querying and manipulation.
Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis and machine learning, including hands-on experience using common ML libraries.
Proficiency with Git and version control in collaborative settings.




What we offer

A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views
An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact
Great opportunities for professional development
Health - 5 000 kr wellness allowance
Conference abroad every other year
Breakfast and fruits every day, as well as "holy fika” each Friday
Regular after work and celebrated successes at the office




Apply today and be a part of Northmill!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist
We're partnering with an established fintech that's using data science to solve complex business problems at scale. Operating in a highly digital environment, data sits at the centre of decision-making, giving the team the opportunity to test ideas quickly, measure outcomes, and create meaningful impact across the business.
As the company continues to invest in its Data & ML capabilities, they're looking for a Data Scientist to join a collaborative team where curiosity, analytical thinking and commercial impact are valued just as highly as technical expertise.
About the role:This is an opportunity to apply statistics, machine learning and advanced analytics to solve real business problems. You'll work closely with commercial teams to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities, and develop data-driven solutions that create measurable value.
The role has a particular focus on marketing and growth, but you'll be joining a wider Data Science function and working alongside experienced Data Scientists on a variety of business-critical initiatives.
This is a role for someone who enjoys asking the right questions, applying the appropriate analytical techniques, and taking ownership of problems from initial exploration through to models being deployed into production and delivering measurable impact.
What you'll do:Frame business challenges as data science problems and identify the most appropriate analytical approach.Develop statistical and machine learning models that improve decision making and business performance.Design and evaluate experiments, causal analyses and predictive models to generate actionable insights.Work closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities and translate data into commercial value.Partner with engineering teams to ensure models are successfully deployed, monitored and continue delivering value in production.Identify new opportunities where data science can improve efficiency and support business growth.
About you:We're looking for someone with a strong academic foundation who enjoys applying theory to real-world business challenges.
You'll likely have:3+ years' experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role.A degree in Mathematics, Statistics or another highly quantitative discipline, with a Master's degree or above preferred.Strong Python skills for data analysis, statistical modelling and machine learning.Excellent understanding of statistical methods, modelling techniques and when to apply them appropriately.Experience building models that have been deployed into production and created measurable business value.Confidence translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical solutions.Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.A proactive mindset and the ability to take ownership from problem definition through to business impact.
Experience working with marketing analytics, experimentation, attribution or customer behaviour would be beneficial, but the strongest candidates will be those with excellent data science fundamentals and a passion for solving business problems.
Why join?This is a business where data genuinely drives decisions. With a highly digital product and rich datasets, you'll be able to form hypotheses, test them quickly and see the impact of your work in real time.
You'll be joining a collaborative Data & ML team within an established fintech that combines the stability of a successful business with the agility and autonomy of a smaller organisation. Rather than working on isolated research projects or predefined tickets, you'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, influence decision-making and see your work translate into measurable commercial outcomes.
The company offers a flexible hybrid working model (typically two to three days a week in their central Stockholm office), modern tooling, excellent benefits and the opportunity to work alongside experienced Data Scientists in an environment that values continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.
If you're a Data Scientist who enjoys combining strong statistical thinking with practical problem solving - and wants to see your work make a tangible business impact - we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Scania Asset Management
Description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Ventures and New Business at Scania have a key role in contributing to this vision. We drive the industry transformation: At Ventures and New Business we develop complementing solutions to our core and build new growth through ventures and investments. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Scania is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help shape how we understand, value, price, and manage electric vehicle assets over time.

This role is for someone who wants to own complex analytical problems, not only build models. You will work with imperfect operational data, commercial tradeoffs, and decisions that matter: residual value, pricing, lifecycle planning, asset risk, and long-term value creation.

Role Summary

You will join a small team with broad responsibilities and close contact with business, finance, product, engineering, and data colleagues. Your work will connect data science with real asset decisions, from assumptions and analysis to model services and recommendations that others can rely on.

Prior experience with electric vehicles, batteries, finance, fintech, pricing, risk, or asset valuation is valuable, but not required. We are looking primarily for seniority in judgement, ownership, and the ability to create clarity in complex problem areas.

Job Responsibilities



Develop models for battery-electric vehicle usage, remaining useful life, residual value, pricing, lifecycle forecasting, and portfolio risk.
Turn data such as mileage, energy usage, battery health, charging behavior, and asset value into clear decision support.
Define, test, and document assumptions around lifetime, degradation, refurbishment, second-life value, pricing, and risk exposure.
Improve, maintain, and operate deployed models and decision-support services used in real business decisions, including APIs, scheduled jobs, tests, monitoring, and versioning.
Communicate technical and financial reasoning clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.



Who You Are

You likely have:



Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience working across modelling, analysis, data quality, and production-quality code.
Experience building models that support business decisions, for example in pricing, risk, forecasting, asset valuation, lifecycle economics, finance, fintech, or portfolio analytics.
Cloud experience, including deploying or operating data products, APIs, scheduled jobs, model services, or similar workloads.
Demonstrated ownership from unclear business problem to model, data pipeline, deployment, adoption, and maintenance.
Strong self-leadership: you structure ambiguous work, make sound tradeoffs, challenge weak assumptions, and help raise the quality around you.
A Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science, economics, or a related discipline.



This Is Us

Everyone working at Scania is united by a common purpose: Driving the shift towards a sustainable transport system. We know that the transport industry must change, and it’s a change we want to lead. At Ventures and New business, we develop complementing solutions to our core and build new growth through ventures and investments that can accelerate us in driving the shift.People are core to our business. By joining our journey towards a sustainable transport system, you are contributing to the future of transport. You are part of a team that can create real change. At Ventures and New Business, we want to engage and inspire our full organization to create results together with us. Collaboration and entrepreneurial spirit is part of our culture and what makes us successful. By joining us you will be a part of driving meaningful growth in new ways!

Scania Offers

We offer you the chance to be part of an organization that is focused on reaching Scania’s targets and to truly drive the industry transformation. People who work here have the motivation and desire to constantly make things better.

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-31. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:

Aleksandra Kulpa, Talent Acquisition Specialist, aleksandra.x.kulpa@scania.com

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Vill du använda data och AI för att lösa affärskritiska utmaningar som påverkar miljontals kundmöten varje dag? Som Senior Data Scientist på ICA Sverige får du arbeta nära verksamheten och utveckla datadrivna lösningar för flera av ICAs verksamheter.

Om rollen som Senior Data scientist

Som Senior Data Scientist kommer du att vara en nyckelspelare inom vårt Data Science-team. I din roll ansvarar du för att driva data science-projekt från konceptstadiet till produktion, samt säkerställa att lösningarna är tekniskt effektiva och i linje med verksamhetens krav. Du förväntas även vara en mentor för juniora kollegor och bidra till att höja den tekniska nivån inom teamet, men också se till att lösningarna inte bara fungerar tekniskt utan också levererar maximalt affärsvärde. 

Det betyder att du kommer att: 


Arbeta nära våra Data Engineers och verksamhetsexperter för att utveckla och implementera datadrivna lösningar. 
Agera teknisk expert i komplexa projekt, med fokus på skalbarhet och affärsnytta. 
Vara ansvarig för hela data science-flödet, från insamling och bearbetning av data till avancerad modellering och implementering. 
Arbeta med stora datamängder, identifiera användbara signaler och omsätta dessa i affärsstrategier. 
Aktivt delta i beslut om tekniska vägval och lösningsstrategier inom AI och data science. 



Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har lång erfarenhet och djup kunskap inom data science och maskininlärning. Du har tidigare arbetat i seniora roller där du lett komplexa data science-projekt från idé till produktion och har erfarenhet av att arbeta med affärskritiska frågor. 

Vi ser gärna att du har: 


Minst 5 års erfarenhet av arbete som Data Scientist, med fokus på maskininlärning, AI och avancerad analys. 
Gedigen erfarenhet av att arbeta med Python, SQL och molnbaserade lösningar (gärna i GCP). 
Stark kompetens inom statistik, matematik eller datavetenskap, med dokumenterad erfarenhet av att omsätta teorier till praktiska affärsdrivna lösningar. 
Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, DevOps, CI/CD, och andra moderna mjukvaruutvecklingskoncept. 



Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad med ett starkt eget driv. Du har en förmåga att kommunicera och anpassa tekniska insikter till affärsnytta för både tekniska och icke-tekniska stakeholders samt delar med dig av din kunskap till mer juniora kollegor. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Vad händer nu?

Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag då urval sker löpande, sista ansökningsdag 30/8.

För frågor om tjänsten, kontakta rekryterande chef Ola Ottosson, ola.ottosson@ica.se och för frågor om processen, kontakta rekryterare Josefine Åsmyr, josefine.asmyr@ica.se.

ICA ska spegla våra kunder och samhället, vi strävar därför efter att anställa människor med olika bakgrund, kompetenser, kunskap och erfarenheter. Om roller kräver det så behöver du genomgå tester, bakgrundskontroller och drogtestning innan anställning.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Nepa is a strategic marketing intelligence and optimization platform with AI built into everything we do — helping iconic global brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt make smarter marketing decisions, faster.

About the Role

As a Data Scientist at Nepa, you'll turn marketing and brand data into decisions our clients act on. You'll work independently on your own workstreams — designing and building the models, pipelines and analyses that power client projects and our AI-driven products — with senior colleagues close by for the hardest calls. This role suits people who'd rather own a problem end to end than wait to be told how to solve it: one week you might be automating a machine learning pipeline, the next presenting your findings straight to a C-level client stakeholder.

Your Responsibilities

As our Data Scientist, your key responsibilities will include:

Designing and building statistical, machine learning and AI models, pipelines and analyses for client projects and our products.
Translating client business questions into sharp, testable analytical problems.
Using AI to work smarter — automating recurring delivery steps like data preparation, quality checks and reporting, and building faster with AI assistants.
Helping embed AI and machine learning into our products — from a smarter model component in our Continuous MMM to a new signal in Creative AI, our tool for analyzing what makes ad creative perform.
Owning your workstreams end to end, from quality to timelines.
Presenting your findings clearly to your team and, increasingly, directly to clients.

Your Profile

To excel in this role, you should have:

A degree in a quantitative engineering or mathematics field.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Around 1–3 years of hands-on data science and/or data engineering experience.
Strong statistics and applied machine learning, solid Python, and good engineering habits.
A builder's instinct — you spot where a method or process can be improved, and you make it happen.
Comfort with ambiguity: you can choose a sound approach when there's no textbook answer.
Clear communication — you can explain complex analysis to technical and non-technical people alike.
You must have the legal right to work in Sweden. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role.
Nice to have: hands-on experience using AI tools or assistants to speed up your own delivery.

We know great candidates don't always check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd still love to hear from you.

A Few More Details

You believe in the power of data and AI to drive smarter decisions and lasting growth.
You share our values: curiosity that sees what others don't, passion that shows, clarity over complexity, and the drive to care and act.
You want the freedom to grow in your own way, backed by the guidance and support of a close-knit team.
You take pride in delivering the clarity, speed, and impact our clients rely on.




Who We Are

At Nepa, we help great brands grow by turning insight into action. We're building a strategic marketing intelligence and optimisation platform for the AI era — connecting continuous data with sharp analytics, machine learning and deep marketing expertise, so businesses can act faster, spend smarter, and focus on what really drives results.




Our platform brings together Brand Tracking, Marketing Mix Modelling and Campaign Evaluation into one clear, AI-powered view for marketers and the C-suite alike. It's a transformation with real momentum: we're profitable, our subscription business is accelerating, and our AI-driven products are already proving out in the market. Our Continuous MMM tracks what's driving performance on an ongoing basis rather than waiting for a quarterly report, and our new Creative AI has already helped a client uncover a 40%+ potential reduction in cost-per-acquisition by identifying which creative elements in their ads actually move the needle. We're just getting started — for the right person, that's a real opportunity to help shape what comes next.




We're trusted by more than 300 blue-chip clients across 50+ markets — including brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt — and we track over 7,500 brands and campaigns every day. Founded in Stockholm in 2006 and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Nepa has grown into a team of around 220 people across 10 offices on six continents. We're proud to bring clarity to complexity, and to make insight an engine for growth.

Next Steps

We review applications on a rolling basis, so don't delay — submit your application today to be considered for this exciting opportunity to join our team as a Data Scientist.

Description:
Omvandla organisationers AI-ambitioner till mätbart affärsvärde




AI har gått från framtidsvision till en affärskritisk prioritet. Organisationer inom alla branscher utforskar hur AI kan förbättra beslutsfattande, effektivisera verksamheter och skapa nya affärsmöjligheter.




Många har redan tagit de första stegen genom pilotprojekt och experiment. Utmaningen handlar nu om att skala initiativen, operationalisera modeller och bygga lösningar som levererar verkligt värde över tid.




Våra kunder söker praktiska och hållbara sätt att använda AI för att lösa konkreta affärsutmaningar. De behöver lösningar som är tekniskt robusta, relevanta för verksamheten och som skapar förtroende hos de människor som ska använda dem.




Som Data Scientist på Nexer Insight hjälper du kunder att identifiera möjligheter, utveckla intelligenta lösningar och ta AI från idé till produktion. Ditt arbete påverkar hur organisationer använder AI, fattar beslut och skapar värde i en av vår tids mest betydelsefulla teknikförändringar.




Utmaningar du kommer att arbeta med:

Förbättra beslutsfattande genom avancerad analys
Tillämpa Machine Learning på komplexa affärsutmaningar
Skala AI-initiativ inom organisationen
Bygga förtroende för AI genom styrning och ansvarsfull användning
Skapa mätbart värde från investeringar i data och AI




Projekt/arbetsuppgifter du kan bli en del av:

Utveckla AI-lösningar som stödjer affärskritiska beslut
Bygga prediktiva modeller för prognoser, optimering och riskhantering
Skapa Generative AI-lösningar baserade på LLM:er och Retrieval-Augmented Generation
Utveckla AI-assistenter som förbättrar produktivitet och kundupplevelser
Hjälpa kunder att identifiera och prioritera AI-möjligheter




Du använder din tekniska expertis och affärsförståelse för att driva idéer hela vägen till mätbara resultat hos kunder.




Tekniker och plattformar du kan komma att arbeta med:

Azure AI Services
Azure Machine Learning
Microsoft Fabric
Databricks
Python
PySpark
LLM:er
Generative AI
MLOps




Varför Nexer Insight?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett team med arkitekter, data engineers, data scientists och AI-specialister som tillsammans hjälper kunder att lösa komplexa verksamhets- och teknikrelaterade utmaningar.




Du får möjlighet att lära av erfarna kollegor, påverka tekniska beslut och arbeta nära kunder i projekt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.




Du blir en del av ett team vars kompetens har uppmärksammats av Microsoft genom vårt Solutions Partner-status och våra Advanced Specializations inom Analytics på Microsoft Azure samt Data & AI. Det är certifieringar som endast ett fåtal organisationer i Norden har, vilket speglar den erfarenhet, specialistkompetens och leveransförmåga som finns hos våra medarbetare.




Vi är även Databricks Consulting Partner med Select-status, vilket ger oss möjlighet att arbeta nära en av marknadens ledande plattformar för data, analys och AI. För dig innebär det möjligheten att arbeta med moderna teknologier, erfarna specialister och några av marknadens mest spännande data- och AI-initiativ.




Med rötter i svensk entreprenörsanda och innovation har vi hjälpt kunder att ligga steget före sedan internets början – i allt från strategi till teknik och kommunikation.




Idag är vi en betrodd partner för några av världens största och mest krävande organisationer.

Vi hjälper organisationer att omsätta data och AI till mätbart affärsvärde genom att kombinera strategi, styrning, teknik och förändringsledning. På så sätt skapar vi förutsättningar för ansvarsfull AI-adoption, datadrivet beslutsfattande och långsiktig tillväxt.




För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har erfarenhet av:

Python och PySpark

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Digital Sales Personal Banking
Description:
Job ID: 5575

Would you like to empower business to unlock the potential of data? We are growing our team in Data, Digital Sales and Engagement (DDSE) Sweden. We are now looking for a Senior Data Scientist who can help us to utilise more data and insight to engage with customers in different interactions.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

About Our Team

In Data, Digital Sales and Engagement (DDSE) we are a group of specialists in various fields: everything from digital marketing and content production to web analysis and data science. Collectively, we are responsible for engaging new and existing personal customers in digital channels and driving sales via online/mobile banking and nordea.se. We are building the omnichannel customer journey experience and for that we need to connect different data sources across our platforms and applications. Right product, right process, right message, right channel, at the right time for the right customer.

The role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

About This Opportunity

We are looking for a curious and driven Senior Data Scientist who will play a key role in implementing our omnichannel customer journey strategy. You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively with stakeholders in Personal Banking. In this role, you will enable Digital Sales to leverage data and analytics to enhance the customer experience. You will deliver insights and recommendations, drive automation through model-based solutions, simplify processes, and identify new data sources. Together with the team, you will develop advanced AI models to predict customer needs and behaviours in digital channels.

In addition you will be:


Analysing how our omnichannel business is developing including e.g. sales, activity performance, customer behaviour, pricing, process steps and demand
Designing and developing customer engagement activities: suggest target group, evaluate data availability, support utilizing sufficient control groups, monitor the outcome of activities, and evaluate the results
Participating actively in the work of digital customer journey teams, training and coaching the team to utilize data & analytics
Enabling data for analytics, reporting and marketing automation tool(s)
Recommending and performing analysis of different data sources to spot development trends and pain points
Together with a wider data analyst community and take part into building analytics & tools needed for business development


Who You Are

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imagine you share with us.

We are looking for someone passionate about data and analytics, with the ability to turn data into insights, ideas and opportunities that support strong customer experiences. You take ownership of the full data science lifecycle—from data gathering and engineering to modelling—while keeping a clear business focus.

To succeed in this role, we believe that you are/have:


Interest in business and customer behaviour
Good at collaboration in practice - work closely with other Subject Matter Experts, involve stakeholders and always asking questions and investigating alternative solutions
Can drive tasks on your own but equally skilled in facilitating collaboration around tasks while maintaining the customer centric mindset
Innovative, openminded and excited about bringing your ideas to the table. You strive for continuous improvement and love learning and trying out new things. You're dependable, willing to speak up even when it's difficult, and committed to empowering others
A proactive, innovative and can-do oriented mind-set with the ability to convert new ideas into concrete actions, share “make it happen attitude”
A passion to share your knowledge and a ability to clearly communicate complex issues in an easy and understandable manner to a wide range of stakeholder


Your experience and background:


At least 3-5 years of experience in data analytics/data science
You are comfortable in using one or more data science programming language e.g. Python, R, SQL
You know your ways around tools like Hive, Snowflake, visualization tool such as Power BI
You understand the principles of working with an Agile development approach
Academic degree in highly quantitative discipline or specialisation such as Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or Finance, and you have understanding of statistical concepts (e.g. Hypothesis Testing) and machine learning models
Proficient in written and spoken Swedish and English


What We Offer

By joining Nordea you can impact on the life of 11 million customers. Our team has an important role in helping to inspire and educate business teams on effectively utilizing data to drive informed decision-making. Joining the team will provide you with opportunities to use your experience with data management, data analysis and data engineering to support business developers, leaders, digital marketing specialists & other stakeholders.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Please submit your application no later 06/09/2026. Remember that we don´t accept applications via email. Interviews will be held continuously. For more information about the position, you are more than welcome to contact Sebastian Kovacs, Head of PeB analytics SE, +46 76-8239114, Sebastian.kovacs@nordea.se.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Wolt+ Analytics
Description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About The Consumer Loyalty Analytics At Wolt

At Wolt, we are committed to creating a seamless and rewarding experience for our customers. The Consumer Loyalty Analytics team plays a key role in driving initiatives that foster user engagement, retention, and long-term loyalty.

Our mission is to provide data-driven insights and solutions that enhance the core loyalty program - Wolt+ which is our premium subscription program that offers free delivery and many other exclusive benefits to millions of members.

About the Wolt+ Domain

Wolt+ is our premium subscription program designed to enhance the convenience and value of the Wolt experience. By offering free delivery and exclusive perks, Wolt+ encourages frequent and loyal usage across our platform.

The Wolt+ domain focuses on growing the subscriber base, improving user engagement, and maximizing retention by delivering compelling benefits and a seamless subscription experience. Our work involves optimizing pricing, enhancing the value proposition, and ensuring that Wolt+ meets the needs of customers across diverse markets.

As part of this team, you’ll work closely with product, and business & operations teams to uncover insights, measure program performance, and develop data-driven strategies that drive Wolt+ adoption and long-term customer loyalty.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Our humble expectations


5+ years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science position.
Expertise in statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing, experimentation using statistical software packages in Python, R, or equivalent for product development (preferably consumer-facing).
Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets.
Have prior experience building intuitive data visualizations and dashboards that influence business decisions, utilizing tools like Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar.


What we offer


The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Helsinki or Stockholm. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the locations above 💙
You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.


Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Product+ Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via zhanna.filintseva@wolt.com

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
