Title: Kvantitativ analytiker till Svenskt Näringsliv (tidsbegränsad anställning)
Description:
Är du nyexaminerad och vill utvecklas i en spännande roll på en dynamisk arbetsplats? Känner du ett starkt engagemang för att arbeta med Svenskt Näringsliv och delar visionen - ett växande näringsliv i ett fritt samhälle - då ser vi gärna att du söker tjänsten som kvantitativ analytiker!

Vi söker dig som är i början av din karriär och har en masterexamen inom nationalekonomi eller statistik.

Om rollen

Strukturreformsenheten på Svenskt Näringslivs samhällsekonomiska avdelning söker en kvantitativ analytiker som ska arbeta med dataanalys. Du kommer att bistå några av våra seniora analytiker i olika projekt. De huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifterna är datainsamling och -bearbetning samt presentation av resultat i form av resultattabeller, figurer och rapporttext.

De flesta av oss på Strukturreformsenheten är nationalekonomer och vi jobbar med frågeställningar som täcker tillväxt; arbetsmarknaden; entreprenörskap; välfärdsföretagens villkor; kommunsektorns ekonomi; med mera. I många fall är slutprodukten av vårt arbete rapporter som publiceras på Svenskt Näringsliv, men även interna promemorior, vetenskapliga artiklar, med mera, förekommer.

Vi sitter i trevliga lokaler centralt i Stockholm. Anställningen är på heltid och sker via Academic Work. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten är tidsbegränsad och förväntas initialt pågå under ett år, med möjlighet till förlängning.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har en masterexamen i nationalekonomi eller statistik. Tjänsten passar dig som är i början av din karriär och vill utvecklas inom området.

Du ska ha ett stort intresse av både samhällsekonomi och kvantitativa metoder. Du har läst kurser i ekonometri och har praktisk erfarenhet av mikroekonometri och goda programmeringskunskaper, helst i R. Du kan ta del av forskningslitteratur och har god förmåga att ta fram skattningar utifrån statistiska ekvationer och övriga anvisningar. Sökande med masterexamen i statistik behöver ha dokumenterade kunskaper i nationalekonomi.

Som person är du samvetsgrann, bra på att samarbeta, flexibel och prestigelös. Du är kommunikativ och uttrycker dig mycket väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.

Svenskt Näringsliv är en tydligt värderingsdriven organisation och våra medarbetare förutsätts dela organisationens grundvärderingar, som vikten av en väl fungerande marknadsekonomi och fri företagsamhet som leder Sverige till ökat välstånd.

Ansökan

Sista ansökningsdag är 30 augusti 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande så ansök gärna så snart som möjligt. Frågor besvaras av Nikolay Angelov, kvantitativ analytiker (nikolay.angelov@svensktnaringsliv.se, 072-209 46 27) och Jonas Frycklund, chef för Strukturreformsenheten och biträdande chefekonom (jonas.frycklund@svensktnaringsliv.se, 070-568 80 27).

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Svenskt Näringsliv

Vi vill att dagens och morgondagens företag ska ha de bästa förutsättningarna att starta, driva och utveckla sin verksamhet. Vi tar fram förslag på åtgärder och reformer som gagnar företagsklimatet. Vi sprider kunskap och bildar opinion. Vi företräder företagen i samtal med fackliga organisationer och myndigheter. Vi ger det svenska näringslivet en röst i EU.

Vår vision är att dagens och morgondagens företag ska ha de bästa förutsättningarna att starta, driva och utveckla sin verksamhet. Med det menar vi att dagens och morgondagens företag ska ha de bästa förutsättningarna att starta, driva och utveckla sin verksamhet. Sverige ska ha högre tillväxt än andra länder och det svenska näringslivet ska växa snabbare än globala konkurrenter.

Över tre miljoner människor arbetar i näringslivet och är direkt beroende av företagen för sin försörjning. Alla andra är också beroende av näringslivet eftersom de som jobbar i näringslivet skapar efterfrågan och bidrar med varor, tjänster och skatteintäkter som håller i gång ekonomin och välfärden i stat, region och kommun.

Vi företräder 60 000 små, medelstora och stora företag. Dessa är organiserade i 49 bransch- och arbetsgivarförbund. Förbunden utgör föreningen Svenskt Näringslivs medlemmar. Företag är primärt med i ett arbetsgivarförbund och/eller i en branschorganisation. Genom detta blir de även medlemsföretag i Svenskt Näringsliv.

Title: Postdoktor inom datorseende med inriktning mot modellering av rörelse
Description:
Arbetsuppgifter



Målet med projektet är att utveckla videobaserade metoder för modellering av mänsklig rörelse, med tillämpningar mot 3D-poseestimering, aktivitetsigenkänning och generering av syntetisk rörelse. Projektet innefattar datainsamling med mocaputrustning och programmering av generativa maskininlärningsmodeller.

Krav

Avlagd doktorsexamen eller utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara en doktorsexamen. Detta behörighetskrav ska vara uppfyllt senast vid tidpunkten då anställningsbeslutet fattas.
Vetenskaplig skicklighet, dokumenterad genom publikationer i internationella konferenser och tidskrifter inom datorseende.

Den sökande bör ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av maskininlärning, speciellt programmering av djupa neurala nätverk. Du bör också ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av datorseende, bildbehandling eller signalbehandling, samt erfarenhet av datainsamling med olika mocapsystem.



Meriterande

Vid sista ansökningsdag högst tre år sedan doktorsexamen eller en utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara doktorsexamen avlades.

Medvetenhet om mångfalds- och likabehandlingsfrågor med särskilt fokus på jämställdhet
Samarbetsförmåga
Självständighet

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.

Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH.



Fackliga representanter



Kontaktuppgifter till fackliga representanter.



Ansökan



Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in.



Ansökan ska innehålla: 

CV inklusive relevant yrkeserfarenhet och kunskap.
Kopia av examensbevis och betyg från dina tidigare universitetsstudier. Översättningar till engelska eller svenska om de ursprungliga dokumenten inte utfärdas på något av dessa språk.
Kortfattad redogörelse för varför du vill bedriva forskning, dina akademiska intressen och hur de relaterar till dina tidigare studier och framtida mål. max 2 sidor lång. 

Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).

Anställningen gäller tillsvidare, dock längst två år

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Messaging Platform
Description:
Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission focuses on converting listeners into lifelong subscribers by delivering seamless, valuable experiences across pricing, packaging, and customer journeys. We build the systems and tools that power acquisition, retention, and overall subscription growth at scale.

The Messaging Platform powers Spotify’s communications to over a billion users — from push notifications to emails and in-app messages that connect listeners to the content they love. Within this space, the Paloma squad focuses on message optimization: deciding which message reaches which user, through which channel, and at what moment.

We’re evolving how messaging works at Spotify — moving from short-term optimization toward systems that understand long-term user journeys. By combining reinforcement learning approaches with deeper domain signals, we’re expanding how machine learning shapes the entire messaging funnel.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and ship machine learning models that optimize messaging across push, email, and in-app channels
Plan and run A/B experiments in a multi-objective environment, balancing conversion, engagement, retention, and reachability
Contribute to reinforcement learning systems that optimize for long-term user outcomes rather than immediate interactions
Partner with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to define what success looks like and how to measure it
Own the full ML lifecycle, from data and modeling to deployment, monitoring, and iteration
Integrate ML models with upstream systems, including domain value signals and opportunity generation frameworks
Help shape the future of AI-assisted development within the team, exploring how tools can accelerate experimentation and delivery


Who You Are


You have strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production environments at scale
You are comfortable translating business problems into ML solutions and discussing trade-offs with cross-functional partners
You have worked on complex optimization problems such as ranking systems or multi-objective decision-making
You bring hands-on experience with PyTorch and distributed systems such as Ray or similar frameworks
You understand experimentation deeply and can design reliable tests in environments with interacting metrics
You are able to analyze results using approaches like causal inference or metric decomposition when needed
You have experience with or curiosity about reinforcement learning and long-term optimization systems
You enjoy working across disciplines and navigating ambiguity while shaping strategy and direction


Where You'll Be


This role is based in London and Stockholm
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home


Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice

Title: Optimisation Engineer
Description:
About us

Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most.




The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger.




Watch our film




About the team

At Ingrid, our tech team builds and maintains an in-house optimisation engine to maximise battery efficiency within the grid. We also focus on creating a data-driven culture by building data pipelines and a Business Intelligence layer to provide stakeholders with actionable insights. Our team plays a key role in driving strategic decision-making and overall company success, and we work closely together to ensure a smooth transition of ideas from concept to reality. At Ingrid, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where everyone’s voice is valued. We believe in empowering our team members to make a real impact.




About the role

As our Optimisation Engineer at Ingrid, you'll lead efforts in optimising battery storage to support the grid and transition to renewable energy. You'll be key in improving our battery optimisation algorithms, ensuring they operate at peak efficiency. This role requires strong mathematical skills and a mix of optimisation techniques. The impact of your work on our revenue is substantial, with an annual output that continues to grow. You'll collaborate across teams to incorporate diverse data into our models and translate insights into actions.




Location: Stockholm (on-site)




What you'll do

Contribute to the evolution of our battery system optimisation algorithms. Craft and refine them to maximise efficiency and economic performance, leveraging multi-stage optimisation strategies.
Apply your mathematical expertise to real-world energy challenges. Apply deep mathematical knowledge and cutting-edge problem formulation techniques to tackle intricate energy storage challenges using stochastic optimisation, linear programming, and reinforcement learning.
Bridge the data gap. Collaborate closely with your team to seamlessly integrate forecasts and other crucial data into our optimisation models.
Champion innovation. Cultivate a culture of continuous improvement by actively contributing to the advancement of our data science and optimisation approaches.
Collaborate to optimise. Work closely with stakeholders to align business goals with tailored optimisation solutions.




Who we think you are

Ideally, you have experience from the energy sector, particularly battery storage or renewable energy systems, and experience in battery optimisation or hydro optimisation is, of course, very meritorious. You have a track record of innovation and a problem solving mindset, in complex, data-driven projects.




Here's what will set you up for success:

Experienced Optimiser: You have proven experience in optimisation, data science, operations research, applied mathematics, or other related field, with a strong foundation in optimisation algorithms and/or machine learning.
Math Mastermind: Solid foundation in mathematical concepts essential for optimisation modeling, including linear programming and scenario analysis.
Technical Expertise: You're comfortable applying various optimisation methods, including linear programming. Proficiency in Python or another suitable programming language for optimisation tasks is required.




For this role, we think you have an educational background in mathematics, engineering physics, data science, energy systems, computer science or similar.




Why join us?

At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration. We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From lunch & learns to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together.




Next step

We’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalise the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match. This process will run over summer vacations and we will keep everyone involved updated on our expected timeline.




We look forward to hearing from you!

/Team Ingrid

Title: MUST söker utvecklare med AI-kompetens
Description:
Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete och bidra till ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld?

Det förändrade omvärldsläget medför att vårt försvar behöver förstärkas och den ökade underrättelseverksamheten mot Sverige och Försvarsmakten är omfattande. Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) bedriver försvarsunderrättelseverksamhet och militär underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänst till stöd för svensk utrikes-, försvars- och säkerhetspolitik samt i övrigt för kartläggning av yttre hot mot Sverige.

Vi söker dig som brinner för kod, har en passion för problemlösning och vill sätta din tekniska kompetens i arbeten för att skydda vårt samhälle – och samtidigt driva utvecklingen av banbrytande mjukvaruförmåga inom rymddomän. Hos oss får du möjlighet att designera och implementera mjukvara som nyttjar nästa generations rymdanalys.

Vårt erbjudande

Vi erbjuder ett viktigt och stimulerande arbete där du dagligen bidrar till Sveriges säkerhet. Vi värdesätter kontinuerligt lärande och erbjuder goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling genom deltagande i konferenser, kurser och andra utvecklingsinsatser. Du får tid och förutsättningar att utvecklas och fördjupa dina kunskaper i din yrkesroll. Hos oss finns det friskvårdsmöjligheter som inkluderar träning tre timmar i veckan på arbetstid samt möjlighet att ha balans mellan fritid och arbete.

Om enhetenMust underrättelsekontor ansvarar för inhämtning, bearbetning, analys och delgivning av underrättelser avseende externa hot mot Sverige och svenska intressen. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med övriga funktioner inom Must och Försvarsmakten samt externa myndigheter.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifterSom AI-utvecklare ingår du i ett team som jobbar nära avdelningens domänspecialister inom rymd, geospatial analys och strategisk underrättelse. Vanliga ansvarsområden:


Nyutveckling av verksamhetsnära mjukvaruprogram med korta ledtider
Design av nya verktyg och arbetssätt utifrån användarnas krav och önskemål
Databasmodellering och optimering
Utveckling av AI-stöd i verksamheten


Kvalifikationer


Erfarenhet av programmering i Python eller liknande.
Erfarenhet av databaser, exempelvis SQL eller liknande databastekniker.


MeriterandeAndra kompetenser som också kan vara av intresse:


Akademisk examen inom data- eller systemvetenskap.
Erfarenhet av att använda maskininlärning (ML), till exempel inom text-, bild- eller videobehandling.
Erfarenhet av att bygga robusta IT-tjänster.
Goda kunskaper i Linux och Windows.
Erfarenhet av container- samt orkestreringsteknologier.
Erfarenhet av att använda AI (t ex LLM:er) på nya och kreativa sätt.


Personliga egenskaperDu kommer att arbeta i en kompetent verksamhet som värdesätter hög kvalitet och ställer krav på sina medarbetare, samtidigt som den är lyhörd och öppen för förändring. För att passa för tjänsten bör du trivas med att arbeta resultatinriktat in en operativ miljö samtidigt som du levererar till användarna. Du är prestigelös i ditt förhållningsätt och har förmågan att anpassa dig till varierande arbetsuppgifter, såsom kodning, förberedelser av presentationer och framtagning av bildanalyser. Du värdesätter samarbete och ser ditt team som en tillgång och är mån om att ni gemensamt ska nå utsatta mål. Vidare behöver du ha ett gott omdöme präglat av hög integritet och stort säkerhetsmedvetande. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet. Ovan ställda kvalifikationer ska på begäran kunna verifieras genom intyg, referenser samt arbets- eller urvalstester.

För att myndighetens uppdrag ska vara framgångsrikt förutsätts att alla medarbetare uppträder enligt den värdegrund som finns. Försvarsmaktens värdegrund slår vakt om alla människors lika värde, rättvisa och jämlikhet och främjar demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter (läs mer på www.forsvarsmakten.se).

ÖvrigtAnställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med en provanställning om sex månader

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Arbetsort: Stockholm

Tjänsteresor: Förekommer inom och utanför Sverige

För upplysningar om befattningen eller rekryteringsprocessen kontakta:

hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se , vänligen skriv ”M.J AI-Utvecklare” i ämnesraden.

Fackliga företrädare

Fackliga representanter nås via hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se

Sista ansökningsdag

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-09-08. I ditt CV och personliga brev vill vi att du beskriver på vilket sätt du uppfyller våra efterfrågande krav och meriter. Du ansöker via jobb.forsvarsmakten.se. Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast att tas emot via Försvarsmaktens hemsida.

, Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats. -------------------------------------------------------- Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) är en del av Försvarsmaktens högkvarter i Stockholm. Vi ger regeringen och Försvarsmakten kvalificerade beslutsunderlag om omvärldsutvecklingen och hot mot Sveriges och Försvarsmaktens säkerhet. Vår vision är ”Ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld”. Must är en kunskapsorganisation och erbjuder både spännande och för Sverige angelägna arbetsuppgifter. Här arbetar både officerare och civila experter inom olika områden, t ex statsvetenskap, IT, ekonomi, teknik, matematik och HR. En stor del av Must verksamhet omfattas av sekretess och vi ber dig därför att inte berätta att du sökt jobb hos Must för andra personer än dina närmaste. Läs gärna mer om Must och vår verksamhet här Varje dag och varje timme gör våra medarbetare insatser som påverkar andra människors liv, både i stort och smått, och både på hemmaplan och runt om i världen. Försvarsmakten ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas som människa och växa i din professionella roll. Vi är en ansvarstagande arbetsgivare och har en öppen organisation där vi ställer upp för varandra. I Försvarsmakten finns en stark värdegrund som bygger på öppenhet, resultat och ansvar. Professionell utveckling och personlig hälsa värdesätts och uppmuntras. Det finns goda förutsättningar för intern karriärrörlighet, friskvård och bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Försvarsmakten tillvaratar de kvaliteter som mångfald och jämn könsfördelning tillför verksamheten. Vi välkomnar därför sökanden med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter i våra rekryteringar. En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. I anställningen ingår även en skyldighet att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning. Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas. Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste. 

We’re more than an app: we are a certified B Corporation with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste, so alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast: Our community of 133 million registered users and 261,000 active partners across 21 countries, have together already prevented 517+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.397.000 tonnes of CO2e!

Your mission

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our Product Analytics and Center of Excellence team at Too Good To Go.

In this role, you will help build and scale data science capabilities across product and business domains, enabling smarter, more automated, and more impactful decision-making.

As a marketplace, many of our most critical challenges revolve around supply-demand dynamics, user behavior, and marketplace efficiency. You will work on problems such as personalisation, optimisation, and forecasting, helping us move from reactive analysis to proactive, model-driven systems.

You will work as part of the Center of Excellence, partnering closely with Product, Analytics, and business teams through high-impact, project-based collaborations.

Your role

Partner with Product and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities where data science can drive step-change improvements
Develop and deploy machine learning models and statistical methods to solve problems such as: Personalisation and recommendation systems, Marketplace optimisation (e.g. ranking, matching, supply-demand balance) and Demand and supply forecasting.
Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable models, algorithms, and data products
Design and contribute to experimentation and measurement frameworks to evaluate impact
Collaborate closely with Product Analysts, ML Engineers, and stakeholders within the Product Analytics and Center of Excellence, working in an embedded, project-based model
Take end-to-end ownership, from problem framing to model development and impact evaluation
Contribute to building data science best practices, tools, and standards across the company 

Requirements

Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Econometrics, or a related field
Strong experience applying machine learning and statistical modeling to product or business problems
Experience in at least one of the following areas: Personalisation / recommendation systems, Marketplace or optimisation problems, Forecasting (time series or causal)
Strong programming skills in Python and solid proficiency in SQL
Experience with experimentation (A/B testing) and impact measurement
Ability to operate in ambiguous problem spaces and translate them into structured solutions
Strong communication skills — able to influence product and business stakeholders
High ownership and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Our values

We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We believe in a #oneteam.
We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers and elevate one another.
We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.
We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving. 
We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.

What We Have To Offer

An opportunity to work in a global social-impact company and certified B Corporation! where you can see a real and tangible impact in your role.
To be an integral part of our Data & Analytics team. We are eager for you to make an impact and contribute to the role of analytics across key decisions and our solution processes. Your insights are valuable, and we are here to listen.
Work-life balance is important to us! Focus on the job to be done, not the hours spent, there is no need for overtime.
We trust in our employees and encourage an autonomous environment that provides several opportunities for employees to contribute, develop and take ownership of their work in a way that works for them.
To be part of an international company, with over 1,300+ colleagues across 19 countries that are on the same important mission.
An informal environment, working alongside 170+ passionate people within Tech & Product
We celebrate our differences and our successes and have a strong values-driven team culture.
We work in a hybrid set-up and value in office work weekly.
We may be able to support you with a working visa in Copenhagen, please be prepared to discuss this topic further as your first stage interview.

How to apply

At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste. 

We’re more than an app: we are a certified B Corporation with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste, so alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast: Our community of 133 million registered users and 261,000 active partners across 21 countries, have together already prevented 517+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.397.000 tonnes of CO2e!

Your mission

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our Product Analytics and Center of Excellence team at Too Good To Go.

In this role, you will help build and scale data science capabilities across product and business domains, enabling smarter, more automated, and more impactful decision-making.

As a marketplace, many of our most critical challenges revolve around supply-demand dynamics, user behavior, and marketplace efficiency. You will work on problems such as personalisation, optimisation, and forecasting, helping us move from reactive analysis to proactive, model-driven systems.

You will work as part of the Center of Excellence, partnering closely with Product, Analytics, and business teams through high-impact, project-based collaborations.

Your role

  • Partner with Product and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities where data science can drive step-change improvements
  • Develop and deploy machine learning models and statistical methods to solve problems such as: Personalisation and recommendation systems, Marketplace optimisation (e.g. ranking, matching, supply-demand balance) and Demand and supply forecasting.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable models, algorithms, and data products
  • Design and contribute to experimentation and measurement frameworks to evaluate impact
  • Collaborate closely with Product Analysts, ML Engineers, and stakeholders within the Product Analytics and Center of Excellence, working in an embedded, project-based model
  • Take end-to-end ownership, from problem framing to model development and impact evaluation
  • Contribute to building data science best practices, tools, and standards across the company 

Requirements

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Econometrics, or a related field
  • Strong experience applying machine learning and statistical modeling to product or business problems
  • Experience in at least one of the following areas: Personalisation / recommendation systems, Marketplace or optimisation problems, Forecasting (time series or causal)
  • Strong programming skills in Python and solid proficiency in SQL
  • Experience with experimentation (A/B testing) and impact measurement
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous problem spaces and translate them into structured solutions
  • Strong communication skills — able to influence product and business stakeholders
  • High ownership and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Our values

  • We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We believe in a #oneteam.
  • We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers and elevate one another.
  • We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.
  • We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving. 
  • We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.

What We Have To Offer

  • An opportunity to work in a global social-impact company and certified B Corporation! where you can see a real and tangible impact in your role.
  • To be an integral part of our Data & Analytics team. We are eager for you to make an impact and contribute to the role of analytics across key decisions and our solution processes. Your insights are valuable, and we are here to listen.
  • Work-life balance is important to us! Focus on the job to be done, not the hours spent, there is no need for overtime.
  • We trust in our employees and encourage an autonomous environment that provides several opportunities for employees to contribute, develop and take ownership of their work in a way that works for them.
  • To be part of an international company, with over 1,300+ colleagues across 19 countries that are on the same important mission.
  • An informal environment, working alongside 170+ passionate people within Tech & Product
  • We celebrate our differences and our successes and have a strong values-driven team culture.
  • We work in a hybrid set-up and value in office work weekly.
  • We may be able to support you with a working visa in Copenhagen, please be prepared to discuss this topic further as your first stage interview.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Banking hasn't changed much in decades. We're changing that. One product at a time.

Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank building the future of financial life with AI at the core. Our engineers, designers, and product people work on problems that actually matter. Making money simpler, smarter, and more rewarding for millions of people across the Nordics.

Fully licensed and founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm.

We move fast, we build with purpose, and we're just getting started.

As our new Data Scientist you'll join our team based in Aarhus, reporting to Eugene, our Senior Engineering Manager, working to bring data and machine learning into how we prevent fraud, manage risk, and grow the business.

What will you do?


Design, build, and deploy machine learning and statistical models across fraud detection, transaction monitoring, loan risk assessment, customer risk scoring, and sales and lead generation
Build and operate experimentation and evaluation frameworks — using tools like MLflow and Metaflow — with strong test sets and benchmarks across projects
Dive into data analysis and feature engineering to keep pushing model performance further
Partner closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to define requirements and turn insight into decisions
Document models, methodologies, and results clearly, and bring the latest ML and GenAI advances into how Lunar builds


What are we looking for in you?


Experience developing and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
Proficiency in Python and relevant ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Experience with cloud-based ML platforms such as AWS SageMaker or Kubeflow
Solid grounding in machine learning, statistical modeling, and data analysis techniques — experience in financial services or another regulated industry is a plus
Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business insight


Benefits and perks


4 days in the office. We're a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.
State of the art equipment. The newest computer, monitor, mouse, and keyboard. We want you to do your best work without anything slowing you down.
Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We've got you covered.


Are you ready to join the journey? Apply now and let's find out more!

While you hold on tight for us to get back to you, curious to see what we’re up to? Follow us on LinkedIn for business announcements and releases 📢, check out our Instagram for an inside scoop on what it’s like to work here .

Depending on the regulations in the country where you will be employed, we will ask to see or obtain information about your criminal record. Please note that our employment is conditional upon you not being registered in RKI (Ribers Kredit Information).

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know

Title: Python Developer / Data Scientist
Description:
Python Developer / Data Scientist

Overview

A Python developer with a data science background to become the long-term owner of the NDT project. The developer will co-build across the entire codebase with the current team to understand it and then take over ownership once the current team leaves. From that point, the developer will keep the project running and continuously adapt it to changing business requirements.

Expected Tools & Knowledge

Must have

Python: solid and production-minded

Data science

Experiment tracking with MLflow

Collaborative programming and Git

Self-reliance, with the ability to unblock minor technical issues independently

Nice to have

Classical machine learning

Computer vision

Kubernetes

REST / FastAPI

Responsibilities

Co-build across the entire codebase with the current team and prepare to take full ownership once they leave.

Own the project long term, maintain it, and continuously adapt it to changing business requirements.

Continuously evaluate model performance.

Collect new data and re-trigger model training when needed.

Critically challenge the training data and determine whether a model is good enough to deploy.

Competencies

Python & Software Engineering

Solid, production-minded Python.

Comfortable taking over and maintaining an existing codebase.

Uses Git and works effectively in a collaborative development setup.

Data Science & Model Judgment

Strong grounding in data science.

Questions whether the training data is sound and whether a model is genuinely ready to deploy, rather than trusting metrics at face value.

Evaluates model performance and knows when to collect data and retrain.

Business Stakeholder Interaction

Works directly with business stakeholders to understand and clarify changing requirements.

Translates business requests into concrete changes to the project.

Communicates results and model limitations clearly to non-technical audiences.

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About the Role

We’re seeking a driven Data Scientist to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and bring predictive modelling, experimentation, and applied AI into a team that already understands the business deeply. This is a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.




Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and the Data Platform team. You’ll help move the organisation from “what happened” to “what will happen” - translating business questions into statistical or ML problems, building and validating models, and delivering outputs that plug into the day-to-day work. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.




Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:

Build, validate, and explain predictive models (classification, regression, time-series forecasting, cohort and churn analysis) that connect directly to a business process.
Apply NLP and LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows and unlock new capabilities - prompting, fine-tuning, and deploying language models where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Deliver model outputs in a consumable format, building and enhancing Power BI reports on our Microsoft Fabric data platform for management and internal stakeholders.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations, causal inference) to test what works before scaling.
Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.




What We Are Looking For In You:

1+ years of experience with data science, advanced analytics, or an analytics engineering role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Able to build, validate, and interpret classification and regression models.
Applied NLP and LLM experience. Comfortable prompting, training, and deploying language models to solve real problems.
Experience building predictive models that were actually used in production or by business stakeholders - not just academic exercises.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis or a well-scoped modelling problem.




Why Join Us?

Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.




Great to Have (But Not Required)

Deeper ML & AI intuition - e.g. cross-validation strategy, the bias-variance tradeoff, regularization, gradient-based optimization, model calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and RAG vs. fine-tuning for LLM work.
Exposure to Power BI, DAX, and/or Power Query.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing.
Working knowledge of SQL and comfort pulling data directly from a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).




What we do at OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.




Who we are at OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Title: Data Scientist - vær med til at udvikle prognoser, der holder elnettet i balance
Place: Fredericia, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Data Scientist - vær med til at udvikle prognoser, der holder elnettet i balance

Forestil dig, at din machine learning-model er en del af grundlaget for de beslutninger, der træffes i kontrolcenteret for at sikre strøm til millioner af danskere. I Energinet udvikler vi prognoser og datadrevne beslutningsværktøjer, som bruges til den daglige balancering og drift af det danske elnet. Efterhånden som stadig mere vedvarende energi kobles på systemet, stiger behovet for præcise prognoser, avancerede modeller og intelligent automatisering.

Til vores data science-team søger vi en Data Scientist, der vil være med til at udvikle næste generation af prognoser og machine learning-løsninger til et energisystem i hastig forandring.

Bliv en del af vores specialiserede data science forecasting-team

På kontoret i Fredericia bliver du en del af afdelingen Digitale Balanceringsprodukter, hvor vi arbejder med nogle af Energinets mest forretningskritiske digitale løsninger. Vi udvikler, vedligeholder og forbedrer prognosemodeller, der understøtter kontrolcenterets arbejde med at holde elnettet stabilt og effektivt. Vores løsninger anvendes operationelt hver dag og er et vigtigt input til beslutninger om balancering af elsystemet.

Vi er et tværfagligt team bestående af Software Engineers og Data Scientists, der arbejder tæt sammen om at omsætte store datamængder til robuste og driftssikre løsninger. Samtidig indgår vi i et større setup med andre digitale produktteams, hvor samarbejde og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

"Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde med reelle og komplekse data science-løsninger i en kontekst, hvor modellerne skaber reel værdi hver eneste dag. Vi kombinerer avanceret teknologi med en vigtig samfundsopgave og et solidt fagligt fællesskab,” fortæller Lene Lindstrøm Olsen, Senior Manager.

Du er med til at udvikle Energinets forecasting-løsninger

Du bliver en central del af arbejdet med at udvikle Energinets forecasting-løsninger, og du kommer bl.a. til at:


Udvikle og forbedre machine learning-modeller til prognoser og beslutningsstøtte
Arbejde med store mængder historiske data og realtidsdata
Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til robuste data science-løsninger
Sikre høj kvalitet og stabil drift af modeller i produktion
Samarbejde tæt med specialister, produktfolk og brugere i organisationen
Bidrage til den tekniske retning for teamets data science-løsninger



Samtidig bliver du en del af en spændende udvikling, hvor vi moderniserer vores platforme, udbygger vores arbejde med MLOps og udvikler næste generation af forecasting-løsninger, der skal understøtte fremtidens energisystem.

”Du bliver ikke blot en udførende specialist. Du får også mulighed for at bidrage til både de tekniske løsninger og teamets faglige udvikling,” pointer Lene.

Erfaring med data science og udvikling af modeller

Vi forventer, at du har en længerevarende uddannelse inden for matematik eller data science. Dertil har du flere års erfaring med data science og udvikling af modeller, der skaber værdi i praksis.

Derudover vægter vi positivt, at du har erfaring med:


Python, herunder Pandas og PySpark
Machine Learning og statistisk modellering
Udvikling og drift af modeller i produktionsmiljøer
Azure, Databricks og Delta Lake
Samarbejde på tværs af teknik og forretning



Du er nysgerrig på energisystemer, forecasting og komplekse operationelle problemstillinger, men du behøver ikke at kende energibranchen på forhånd.

Som person motiveres du af at løse komplekse problemer sammen med andre. Du er fagligt dygtig og deler gerne din viden, men du ved også, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab. Du trives med at tage initiativ og har lyst til at omsætte data science til konkrete løsninger.

Vil du være med til at udvikle fremtidens prognoser?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit motiverede CV senest 6. september. Sæt allerede nu et par forsigtige kryds i kalenderen. Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale online 16. september og


samtale i Fredericia 23. september.



Er du nysgerrig på din kommende leder, eller har du spørgsmål til jobbet og teamet? Se nærmere på LinkedIn eller ring til Lene Lindstrøm Olsen på tlf. 5363 6193.

Særlige forhold: Da Energinet løser samfundskritiske opgaver, udfører vi baggrundstjek forud for ansættelsen. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at dit baggrundstjek er foreneligt med ansættelse i Energinet. Baggrundstjekket gennemføres desuden én gang årligt.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede, uanset baggrund, til at søge jobbet. Vi arbejder aktivt og målrettet med mangfoldighed i Energinet og opfordrer dig derfor til at udelade billede, oplysninger om alder, civilstand og lignende, for at minimere ubevidste biases i processen. Du kan læse mere om vores mangfoldighedspolitik her.

Du bliver en del af Energinet Systemansvar, hvis kerneopgaver er at indpasse vedvarende energi, sikre lige adgang til nettene, udvikle markedsdesign, overvåge og balancere transmissionsnettet og at varetage forsyningssikkerheden i Danmark.

Glæd dig til at blive en del af en organisation med et meningsfuldt formål, hvor vi forsyner Danmark med el og gas, og omstiller energisystemet til grøn energi.

For at lykkes med den opgave, skal vi have dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere. Derfor har vi skabt rammer, hvor udvikling prioriteres, nye idéer bliver taget alvorligt, og der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Vi kalder det Energi til mere, og du kan blive endnu klogere på det her

Vi er et tværfagligt team bestående af Software Engineers og Data Scientists, der arbejder tæt sammen om at omsætte store datamængder til robuste og driftssikre løsninger. Samtidig indgår vi i et større setup med andre digitale produktteams, hvor samarbejde og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

"Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde med reelle og komplekse data science-løsninger i en kontekst, hvor modellerne skaber reel værdi hver eneste dag. Vi kombinerer avanceret teknologi med en vigtig samfundsopgave og et solidt fagligt fællesskab,” fortæller Lene Lindstrøm Olsen, Senior Manager.

Du er med til at udvikle Energinets forecasting-løsninger

Du bliver en central del af arbejdet med at udvikle Energinets forecasting-løsninger, og du kommer bl.a. til at:

  • Udvikle og forbedre machine learning-modeller til prognoser og beslutningsstøtte
  • Arbejde med store mængder historiske data og realtidsdata
  • Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til robuste data science-løsninger
  • Sikre høj kvalitet og stabil drift af modeller i produktion
  • Samarbejde tæt med specialister, produktfolk og brugere i organisationen
  • Bidrage til den tekniske retning for teamets data science-løsninger


Samtidig bliver du en del af en spændende udvikling, hvor vi moderniserer vores platforme, udbygger vores arbejde med MLOps og udvikler næste generation af forecasting-løsninger, der skal understøtte fremtidens energisystem.

”Du bliver ikke blot en udførende specialist. Du får også mulighed for at bidrage til både de tekniske løsninger og teamets faglige udvikling,” pointer Lene.

Erfaring med data science og udvikling af modeller

Vi forventer, at du har en længerevarende uddannelse inden for matematik eller data science. Dertil har du flere års erfaring med data science og udvikling af modeller, der skaber værdi i praksis.

Derudover vægter vi positivt, at du har erfaring med:

  • Python, herunder Pandas og PySpark
  • Machine Learning og statistisk modellering
  • Udvikling og drift af modeller i produktionsmiljøer
  • Azure, Databricks og Delta Lake
  • Samarbejde på tværs af teknik og forretning


Du er nysgerrig på energisystemer, forecasting og komplekse operationelle problemstillinger, men du behøver ikke at kende energibranchen på forhånd.

Som person motiveres du af at løse komplekse problemer sammen med andre. Du er fagligt dygtig og deler gerne din viden, men du ved også, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab. Du trives med at tage initiativ og har lyst til at omsætte data science til konkrete løsninger.

Vil du være med til at udvikle fremtidens prognoser?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit motiverede CV senest 6. september. Sæt allerede nu et par forsigtige kryds i kalenderen. Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale online 16. september og

  • samtale i Fredericia 23. september.


Er du nysgerrig på din kommende leder, eller har du spørgsmål til jobbet og teamet? Se nærmere på LinkedIn eller ring til Lene Lindstrøm Olsen på tlf. 5363 6193.

Særlige forhold: Da Energinet løser samfundskritiske opgaver, udfører vi baggrundstjek forud for ansættelsen. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at dit baggrundstjek er foreneligt med ansættelse i Energinet. Baggrundstjekket gennemføres desuden én gang årligt.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede, uanset baggrund, til at søge jobbet. Vi arbejder aktivt og målrettet med mangfoldighed i Energinet og opfordrer dig derfor til at udelade billede, oplysninger om alder, civilstand og lignende, for at minimere ubevidste biases i processen. Du kan læse mere om vores mangfoldighedspolitik her.

Du bliver en del af Energinet Systemansvar, hvis kerneopgaver er at indpasse vedvarende energi, sikre lige adgang til nettene, udvikle markedsdesign, overvåge og balancere transmissionsnettet og at varetage forsyningssikkerheden i Danmark.

Glæd dig til at blive en del af en organisation med et meningsfuldt formål, hvor vi forsyner Danmark med el og gas, og omstiller energisystemet til grøn energi.

For at lykkes med den opgave, skal vi have dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere. Derfor har vi skabt rammer, hvor udvikling prioriteres, nye idéer bliver taget alvorligt, og der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Vi kalder det Energi til mere, og du kan blive endnu klogere på det her

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Drive meaningful change

At our Data, Analytics & AI department, we specialize in data visualizations, BI tools, analytical consulting, statistics, forecasting, and modern data platforms. Working closely with various departments across Abacus, we combine our analytical expertise with a deep understanding of pharmaceutical markets—from product development to delivery.

We believe that robust Data Science and AI can give Abacus Medicine a competitive edge, uncovering trends and behaviors that drive smarter decision-making. Our advanced machine learning (ML) techniques transform complex market data into actionable forecasts. Join us on our growth journey and help shape the future of the pharmaceutical industry.

Get a glimpse of our world

The Data Science team consists of five highly skilled professionals, all dedicated to improve global healthcare through better access to medicine by delivering critical data and insights that drive informed decision-making.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including data analysts, data engineers, product managers, and key business stakeholders—to develop data-driven solutions that scale.

Are you ready to embark on this journey with us?

As a Data Scientist, you will play a key role in developing and deploying machine learning models that power business insights and operational efficiencies and support tactical and strategic decision-making across Abacus Medicine.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Design, develop, and deploy advanced models, including classical machine learning, deep learning, and algorithmic solutions, to solve complex business problems.
Analyze tabular datasets to generate actionable insights, ensuring data-driven decision-making.
Design and maintain scalable MLOps pipelines for seamless model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Promote best practices in Data Science by optimizing workflows and expanding the DS/ML toolbox with tools that enhance model accuracy, runtime, and maintainability.
Strengthen our technical infrastructure by integrating modern technologies that enhance efficiency, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Drive innovation by evaluating and integrating emerging ML/AI methodologies, including LLMs, to enhance model performance.
Translate complex model results into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Share expertise through knowledge sharing and sparring sessions.
Proactively identify potential data science applications for value creation.
Contribute to branch development initiatives and long-term planning, including roadmap definition.


Fuel for your success in the role

We Imagine You Have


Master’s degree in a data science-related field (e.g., computer science, cognitive science, IT, mathematics/statistics, economics).
Advanced Python programming skills.
Proficient in Data Science skills including classical machine learning for tabular data, ML frameworks (scikit-learn, deep learning frameworks), data wrangling, data analysis, and visualization.
Experienced with the following technologies: SQL, Web APIs, Git, Linux commands.
Excellent English communication skills with the ability to present complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Show genuine care for both team dynamics and the success of the organization, fostering a positive and inclusive work culture.


Preferred Qualifications


Prior working experience in applying data science, with a focus on machine learning and predictive modeling.
Familiarity with the following technologies: MLOps, Spark, Cloud platform (e.g. Azure/AWS), mlflow, ETL processes, CI/CD processes.
Databricks environment for building and deploying ML models.
Leveraging LLMs for enhancing the performance of ML models through prompt engineering and embeddings.


Interested?

If you want to apply for the position, please follow the link and attach your CV.

To help us better understand your motivation and qualifications for this role, we kindly encourage you to attach both your cover letter and academic transcript. This will give us a clearer overview of your interests and the courses you have completed during your studies.

Would you like to know more about us?

Follow us on Instagram and LinkedIn and get an insight into everyday life at Abacus Medicine. For job openings, check our Career page.

In Abacus Medicine Group, you’ll experience the power of Moving Healthcare. With our change mindset, we're moving the industry and improving healthcare as we broaden access to medicine.

But it's not just about moving healthcare, it's about Moving You. You’ll be part of a caring community of more than 1,750 people across the World. With us, you will be valued, empowered, and have a direct impact on driving change. Let's access the future of medicine and make a difference together. Your move.

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
In Hearing Care, we are enhancing how data science supports commercial and operational decision-making. As our Senior Data Scientist, you will work close to the business, shape meaningful use cases and help move machine learning from idea to scalable, production-ready solutions.

Making data science matter in business

At Demant, our purpose is to improve people’s lives through hearing health. In this role, you will contribute by helping our Hearing Care business use data and machine learning more effectively – not as an isolated technical exercise, but as a practical capability that supports better decisions and creates measurable value.

Turn business challenges into scalable machine learning solutions

You will join Commercial Excellence in a business-facing data science role. Working closely with commercial and operational stakeholders, you will learn how they work, understand their challenges and decision-making processes, and translate those needs into clear data science and machine learning cases.

You will manage the end-of-the-end data science lifecycle: exploring and preparing data, feature engineering, modelling, experimentation and evaluation. You will build, validate and continuously improve machine learning models, often in data environments that are imperfect, fragmented or still evolving.

A key part of the role is making sure solutions can live beyond the prototype. Together with MLOps, Data Engineers and Architecture, you will help move models into scalable production solutions and follow their performance over time, including model drift, retraining needs and continued business relevance.

The role gives you the opportunity to help shape how data science is used across Hearing Care. As our AI maturity develops, you will have room to shape ways of working, build closer collaboration between business and technology, and build solutions that are practical, governed and adopted in the organisation.

Bring technical depth and business curiosity

You are an experienced data scientist who enjoys getting close to business problems and finding a pragmatic path from data to value. To be effective in the role, we expect that you:



Have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematical Modelling, IT or a similar relevant field.
Bring 3+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modelling and predictive analytics.
Are comfortable across the model development lifecycle, including data exploration, feature engineering, training, validation, production handover, monitoring and retraining.
Have solid Python and SQL skills and can write clean, maintainable code aligned with good software-development practices.
Can work with imperfect or fragmented data and identify what is needed to make a use case feasible.
Communicate complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Are familiar with MLOps practices, CI/CD, model monitoring and production handover.
Have experience working with cloud-based data platforms; we use GCP.
Are fluent in English, as it is our company language.



Want to join us?

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible and no later than August 31th, 2026. We will conduct 1st and 2nd interviews during September. If you would like to know more about the position, you may contact, Manager, Sophia Evtimova on email at sovm@demant.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare group that offers solutions and services to help people with hearing loss connect and communicate with the world around them. The Demant Group operates in a global market with companies in more than 30 countries, employs more than 14,000 staff and generates annual revenue of DKK 14 billion. Demant is the parent company behind the commercial successes of such world-renowned brands as Oticon, Bernafon, Sonic, Audika, Oticon Medical, MAICO, Interacoustics, Amplivox, Grason-Stadler, MedRx and Sennheiser Communications.

The Group’s products are sold in more than 130 countries where we create life-changing differences through hearing health.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

Title: Data Scientist - FP&A
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Role

We’re seeking a driven Data Scientist to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and bring predictive modelling, experimentation, and applied AI into a team that already understands the business deeply. This is a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and the Data Platform team. You’ll help move the organisation from “what happened” to “what will happen” - translating business questions into statistical or ML problems, building and validating models, and delivering outputs that plug into the day-to-day work. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:


Build, validate, and explain predictive models (classification, regression, time-series forecasting, cohort and churn analysis) that connect directly to a business process.
Apply NLP and LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows and unlock new capabilities - prompting, fine-tuning, and deploying language models where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Deliver model outputs in a consumable format, building and enhancing Power BI reports on our Microsoft Fabric data platform for management and internal stakeholders.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations, causal inference) to test what works before scaling.
Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.


What We Are Looking For In You


1+ years of experience with data science, advanced analytics, or an analytics engineering role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Able to build, validate, and interpret classification and regression models.
Applied NLP and LLM experience. Comfortable prompting, training, and deploying language models to solve real problems.
Experience building predictive models that were actually used in production or by business stakeholders - not just academic exercises.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis or a well-scoped modelling problem.


Why Join Us?


Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.


Great To Have (But Not Required)


Deeper ML & AI intuition - e.g. cross-validation strategy, the bias-variance tradeoff, regularization, gradient-based optimization, model calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and RAG vs. fine-tuning for LLM work.
Exposure to Power BI, DAX, and/or Power Query.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing.
Working knowledge of SQL and comfort pulling data directly from a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).


What We Do At OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

Who We Are At OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Please note interviews for this role will be conducted in September

Title: Data Engineer
Place: København SV, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about turning data, AI, and software into practical business solutions? Would you like to work in a global engineering company where digital solutions support the decarbonization of world trade and help colleagues make better decisions every day? Then this could be your next opportunity.

We are looking for a Data / AI Solution Developer to join our Data Management team in PrimeServ Denmark. In this role, you will help design, build, and improve intelligent solutions that combine data, analytics, machine learning, LLMs, and software development to solve real business challenges.

This is not a role focused only on models or only on data pipelines. Designing and developing data-driven and AI-enabled solutions that support business processes and decision-making.
Translating business challenges into technical solution concepts in collaboration with stakeholders and domain experts.
Exploring, preparing, and analyzing data from multiple sources to identify patterns, opportunities, and solution directions.

Title: Join Halfspace’s AI & Advanced Analytics Team - Shaping the Future with AI
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Who We Are

At Halfspace, Part of Accenture - Center for Advanced AI - we believe that the smallest edge can make the biggest difference. We began in sports, predicting outcomes in live football matches, and today we bring that same precision and ambition into the world of business. We're here to unlock value through artificial intelligence and help organisations make better, more informed decisions, faster.

With more than one hundred AI and data projects delivered, our work has transformed industries and earned international recognition. But awards and numbers tell only part of the story. What truly defines us is our people. Our team comes from leading institutions such as KU, DTU, Stanford, Oxford, Harvard, Caltech, Yale, Colombia and many more, blending expertise in physics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, operations research, computer science, chemistry, economics, biology, design and strategy. Together, we share curiosity, boldness, and a pioneering spirit.

Halfspace is a specialized spearheading unit within Accenture, focused on bringing the deepest expertise in applied AI. We are 'Inch Wide - Mile Deep' in our capabilities.

What You'll Be Doing

As part of the AI & Advanced Analytics team at Halfspace, you’ll be working at the cutting edge of artificial intelligence — designing, building, and deploying systems that push what’s possible. You’ll contribute to the development of intelligent agents, generative AI models, and advanced analytical frameworks that deliver real-world impact across industries.

You’ll work alongside engineers, scientists, and strategists from some of the world’s leading institutions, applying deep technical expertise and creative thinking to solve complex problems. From prototyping novel AI applications to operationalizing models at scale, you’ll bridge research and engineering to turn ideas into solutions that redefine performance.

Every experiment, model, and insight you create will help organizations make better decisions, faster — embodying our mission to deliver the smallest edge that makes the biggest difference.

Who We're Looking For

We’re looking for curious and technically exceptional individuals who live at the intersection of AI, mathematics, and software. You combine a strong foundation in statistical modeling and machine learning with the creativity and rigor to turn theory into working systems.

You’re fluent in Python and comfortable working with modern AI stacks — whether that means fine-tuning large language models, architecting agentic systems, or building robust analytical pipelines.

For our Generative AI unit we value:



Strong proficiency in Python and core AI libraries

Experience working with integrating Generative AI and developing AI Agents or other applications

Intellectual curiosity, precision, and a pioneering mindset — the qualities that define Halfspace



For our Advanced Analytics unit we value:



Strong proficiency in Python and core ML libraries

Solid understanding of statistical modeling, optimization, and experimental design

Familiarity with MLOps and model deployment practices

Intellectual curiosity, precision, and a pioneering mindset — the qualities that define Halfspace



If you have less than two years of professional experience, please include your academic transcripts with your application.

Life at Halfspace, part of Accenture

We think and act like a professional sports team. We value flexibility, trust, and balance. We invest in learning and development to keep our team ahead of the curve on everything AI. And we create an environment where ambitious people can grow while working on projects that matter, side by side with some of the world’s leading companies and greatest minds.

About Halfspace, Part Of Accenture

Halfspace was established in 2015. We're on a mission to bring the power of artificial intelligence to industry and deliver exceptional quality and value, whenever we engage, while creating a space which attracts the brightest, most curious and most talented people. As of March 2025 Halfspace became a part of Accenture to help build and grow the Accenture Center for Advanced AI across the Nordics and EMEA.

Title: Data Scientist - Energy Forecasting
Place: Kolding, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
The Impact You'll Make

Are you a data scientist who wants your forecasts to run every day on real energy systems — and to see the economic and carbon impact of the decisions they drive?

Join Danfoss Digital Solutions, Utility, and help build the forecasting foundation for the next generation of district energy optimization.

The Vision We Are Building Towards
District heating and cooling utilities are facing their most demanding transition yet — changing production sources, electrified heat, volatile energy markets and a hard decarbonisation mandate

Our vision is to establish a system-level optimization across production, network and demand, so that a utility can operate at the best possible energy-economic value while delivering on its decarbonisation commitments. Forecasting is playing an important role towards our vision

What You’ll Be Doing
We are looking for a Data Scientist to strengthen the forecasting capability in our Utility team. You will work on the models that tell the platform what is coming and take them from idea to production — running daily on live utility networks — closely guided by experienced data scientists who know these systems well.

Some Of The Key Activities Will Include

Build and improve energy demand forecasting models (heat and cooling load) across a growing portfolio of utility networks and get them into production with automated retraining and minimal manual intervention.
Work on local weather and condition forecasting that outperforms global and regional models at individual network level — a proven differentiator we want to push further.
Make forecasting robust at scale: self-adaptive models, drift and anomaly detection, and forecast accuracy monitoring across many networks at once.
Blend physics with data — combine physical modelling principles of thermal systems with statistical and machine learning methods, rather than treating the network as a black box.
Build and develop the data pipelines your models depend on, together with our data engineering platform team.


The Team
Your main development team is based in Denmark, working with colleagues across several European locations. Beyond your daily team, you join a data science community in Denmark of experienced data scientists working on problems next to yours — production optimization, thermo-hydraulic network simulation, temperature optimization. You will have people to think out loud with, review your models and challenge your assumptions, and you will do the same for them.

What We're Looking For
You are a data scientist who wants to turn messy real-world problems into models that work in production, and who is curious about the physical systems behind the data.

Early in your career? Please apply. We care more about how you think than how many years you have. If you are at a junior level but determined to grow into a deep specialist — rigorous about model quality, curious about how energy systems actually behave, and keen to be challenged by people who know more than you do — we want to hear from you. You will be guided closely by experienced data scientists, and we will invest in getting you there.

On top of that, you should be able to checkmark some of the points listed below:


Hold a Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field (mathematics, machine learning, statistics, physics, etc.)
PhD degree is a benefit, but not a strict requirement
Previous experience of Python as this is used as our main programming tool, together with a solid foundation in statistics and machine learning — from studies, thesis work, internships or professional experience
Experience with forecasting and time-series modelling, especially models that have to run in production
Forecasting experience in energy systems or electricity markets is a plus
Experience with modern data pipelines and cloud-based data platforms
Knowledge with C# and C++ is appreciated as some of our legacy solutions are built with those
Fluent in English
Willing to apply and learn about advanced methodology in the district energy field
Interested in blending physical models of heating and cooling systems with data
Loving to see your code quickly in action, forecasting and optimising large district energy networks


Location
This position is based in our office in Copenhagen or Kolding, Denmark — Copenhagen preferred. We work closely as a team on site, and we are looking for someone who will be based in one of these two locations.

What You'll Get From Us
At Danfoss, we are engineering solutions that allow the world to use resources in smarter ways — driving the sustainable transformation of tomorrow.

Purpose-driven work. District energy is one of the most effective levers for decarbonising heat. The forecasts you build shape how much fuel is burned, how much CO₂ is emitted, and how much value a utility can capture from flexible operation.

A core capability — and support to grow into owning it. Forecasting is not a side feature here; it is the foundation of the product. You start alongside the people who own it today, and grow into carrying it yourself.

Growth. We value continuous development and encourage it through courses, rotations and career tracks.

We believe that innovation and great results are driven by the right mix of people with diverse backgrounds, personalities, skills, and perspectives, reflecting the world in which we do business.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Our Commitment to Transparency
