The Impact You'll Make

Are you a data scientist who wants your forecasts to run every day on real energy systems — and to see the economic and carbon impact of the decisions they drive?

Join Danfoss Digital Solutions, Utility, and help build the forecasting foundation for the next generation of district energy optimization.

The Vision We Are Building Towards
District heating and cooling utilities are facing their most demanding transition yet — changing production sources, electrified heat, volatile energy markets and a hard decarbonisation mandate

Our vision is to establish a system-level optimization across production, network and demand, so that a utility can operate at the best possible energy-economic value while delivering on its decarbonisation commitments. Forecasting is playing an important role towards our vision

What You’ll Be Doing
We are looking for a Data Scientist to strengthen the forecasting capability in our Utility team. You will work on the models that tell the platform what is coming and take them from idea to production — running daily on live utility networks — closely guided by experienced data scientists who know these systems well.

Some Of The Key Activities Will Include
  • Build and improve energy demand forecasting models (heat and cooling load) across a growing portfolio of utility networks and get them into production with automated retraining and minimal manual intervention.
  • Work on local weather and condition forecasting that outperforms global and regional models at individual network level — a proven differentiator we want to push further.
  • Make forecasting robust at scale: self-adaptive models, drift and anomaly detection, and forecast accuracy monitoring across many networks at once.
  • Blend physics with data — combine physical modelling principles of thermal systems with statistical and machine learning methods, rather than treating the network as a black box.
  • Build and develop the data pipelines your models depend on, together with our data engineering platform team.

The Team
Your main development team is based in Denmark, working with colleagues across several European locations. Beyond your daily team, you join a data science community in Denmark of experienced data scientists working on problems next to yours — production optimization, thermo-hydraulic network simulation, temperature optimization. You will have people to think out loud with, review your models and challenge your assumptions, and you will do the same for them.

What We're Looking For
You are a data scientist who wants to turn messy real-world problems into models that work in production, and who is curious about the physical systems behind the data.

Early in your career? Please apply. We care more about how you think than how many years you have. If you are at a junior level but determined to grow into a deep specialist — rigorous about model quality, curious about how energy systems actually behave, and keen to be challenged by people who know more than you do — we want to hear from you. You will be guided closely by experienced data scientists, and we will invest in getting you there.

On top of that, you should be able to checkmark some of the points listed below:

  • Hold a Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field (mathematics, machine learning, statistics, physics, etc.)
  • PhD degree is a benefit, but not a strict requirement
  • Previous experience of Python as this is used as our main programming tool, together with a solid foundation in statistics and machine learning — from studies, thesis work, internships or professional experience
  • Experience with forecasting and time-series modelling, especially models that have to run in production
  • Forecasting experience in energy systems or electricity markets is a plus
  • Experience with modern data pipelines and cloud-based data platforms
  • Knowledge with C# and C++ is appreciated as some of our legacy solutions are built with those
  • Fluent in English
  • Willing to apply and learn about advanced methodology in the district energy field
  • Interested in blending physical models of heating and cooling systems with data
  • Loving to see your code quickly in action, forecasting and optimising large district energy networks

Location
This position is based in our office in Copenhagen or Kolding, Denmark — Copenhagen preferred. We work closely as a team on site, and we are looking for someone who will be based in one of these two locations.

What You'll Get From Us
At Danfoss, we are engineering solutions that allow the world to use resources in smarter ways — driving the sustainable transformation of tomorrow.

Purpose-driven work. District energy is one of the most effective levers for decarbonising heat. The forecasts you build shape how much fuel is burned, how much CO₂ is emitted, and how much value a utility can capture from flexible operation.

A core capability — and support to grow into owning it. Forecasting is not a side feature here; it is the foundation of the product. You start alongside the people who own it today, and grow into carrying it yourself.

Growth. We value continuous development and encourage it through courses, rotations and career tracks.

We believe that innovation and great results are driven by the right mix of people with diverse backgrounds, personalities, skills, and perspectives, reflecting the world in which we do business.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Title: Quantitative Analyst

We’re looking for a Quantitative Analyst with strong analytical instincts and an interest in building production-ready solutions that push the boundaries between quantitative modelling and power trading. You should enjoy turning ideas into reality quickly, working with code, data and complex market dynamics to improve the tools that Nitor relies on every day.




As a Quantitative Analyst at Nitor Energy, you will help advance the models, algorithms and analytical frameworks that power our trading strategies. You will work directly with complex datasets, market dynamics and production-grade code to enhance the accuracy, speed and robustness of our decision-making tools. This role offers hands-on exposure to the full lifecycle of quantitative development in a modern energy-trading company, shaping ideas, testing assumptions and turning data-driven insights into real trading impact.




The Quantitative Analyst we’re looking for is motivated, analytical and want to help elevate our data, models and workflows while accelerating their own development. You should see yourself thriving in a team that executes quickly, turning ideas into production-ready solutions with a pragmatical mindset and sense of ownership.




Your tasks will include

Work closely with traders to develop and refine quantitative models that support profitable trading strategies
Continuously seek improvements to workflows, analytics, risk tools, and business processes
Conduct ad hoc quick analysis to support trading, risk, and commercial decision-making
Design, develop, and maintain analytic and operational views used for monitoring strategies and market dynamics for trading
Support the development and maintenance of Python-based models
Contribute directly to advancing and scaling our data infrastructure




What we expect

Hold a Master within a quantitative field
You have strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Have great python knowledge and an eagerness to code. Other code languages is a plus
You must be a strong team player
We expect you to have a pragmatic mindset and get things done
You have a winning mentality and are willing to go the extra mile to challenge the status quo
You have a do what it takes mentality and do not take no for an answer




What we offer

A young, dynamic, ambitious and fun work environment
Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with experienced colleagues
The opportunity to contribute and make your mark on the team's development
A fun and social work environment with events such as Friday bars, poker tournaments, summer and Christmas parties etc. throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to boost team spirit, such as our Nitor-running club!
Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen
Brand new office facilities located in the heart of Aarhus, right next to Dokk1 and Letbanen




Expected start date: As soon as possible. Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position early if we find the right candidate.

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.




Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
What if your first years in the field of data science and software development were not only about maintenance, but about shaping systems?




At NORDEN, we empower global trade through data, technology and deep industry knowledge. Behind every decision, there is a need to understand risk, navigate uncertainty and create transparency. That is where you come in.




This is a role for someone who is still developing their technical toolbox but is interested in learning, ask questions and grow in a business where technology is closely connected to real-world decisions.




You will not be handed a narrow set of development tasks. Instead, you will be supported by experienced colleagues while gradually taking on more responsibility, exploring new ideas and helping shape solutions from concept to production in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and curiosity are valued.







Why this role?

This role sits at the intersection of software development, engineering and business understanding.

You will work across the full development lifecycle, from understanding business challenges and designing architecture to implementing solutions and ensuring stable operations in production. At the same time, you will gain unique insights into risk management, finance and decarbonisation in a global shipping company.




As a Data Scientist in our Risk Management team, you will help build the systems that support risk measurement, financial performance analysis and decarbonisation initiatives across our business.

You will work with modern technologies in Azure and be part of a team that develops and owns its solutions end-to-end. This means you will see the direct impact of your work and can continuously improve and evolve the systems you build.




Most importantly, you will join a friendly, collaborative and people-focused environment where your ideas are welcomed, your development is supported and your contributions genuinely matter. You will join six teammates in Risk and Financial Analytics who pair an understanding of the business with technical know-how to deliver effective solutions.







What you will be doing

As a Data Scientist, you will play an important role in developing and maintaining analytical solutions that support key business decisions across NORDEN.




Among other things, you will:

Build scalable and maintainable software systems using clean, efficient and well-tested code.
Design, develop and support business-critical applications running in Azure.
Explore opportunities for applying AI to improve processes and create value.
Develop a good understanding of shipping and the business logic behind our systems.
Support risk analysts, voyage performance analysts and finance business partners with reliable and timely solutions.
Collaborate closely with stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our architecture, development practices and operational setup.







What you bring

We want a person who enjoys learning, approaches challenges with insight and uses technology to create solutions.




You likely have:

0-2 years of experience in working in software systems.
A degree within a relevant technical, economic or mathematical field.
A genuine interest in software development and building robust solutions.
Experience with, or an interest in, Azure Cloud technologies.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced English communication skills and the legal right to work in Denmark.




Beyond your technical skills, you enjoy collaborating with others and are comfortable engaging with a variety of stakeholders across the organisation. You are curious, open to new ideas and motivated by continuously improving how things are done.




If you are interested in bringing together software development, business insight and modern cloud technologies at a global company where your work makes a clear difference, we would like to hear from you.







Application

Please upload your motivation letter, resume and relevant diplomas via our website as soon as possible and no later than 21 September. Your motivation letter helps us understand what drives you, why you are interested in the role, and how your skills and experiences could contribute to the team. We are especially interested in your motivation and transferable skills, not a recap of your CV. It is your opportunity to tell us the story behind your application.




We review and interview candidates on an ongoing basis.




We will do our best to get back to you at least within ten working days after the application deadline, 21 September.




In NORDEN we value a range of perspectives, educational backgrounds and professional experience and encourages all qualified candidates to apply.




Were you missing anything in this job ad? Please share your feedback with us here.







Our company

We are a global provider of ocean-based freight services for bulk and project cargo of all sizes. We integrate freight solutions with port logistics, helping our customers optimise and decarbonise supply chains. We provide tailored solutions built on flexibility, reliability, and intelligence.




Our agile business model ensures stability by continuously adapting our fleet to market developments and customer needs.




Founded in 1871, NORDEN is one of Denmark’s oldest internationally operating shipping companies. Incorporated in Denmark, we are listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen as part of the OMX Nordic Large Cap index.




With offices across 6 continents, we are a truly integrated part of global trade.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer (Video Games)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Nørdikat is a small, but highly experienced startup, that is already shipping meaningful machine learning tools and systems to game studios using Unreal Engine 5. As a young company, we’re still shaping how we work and what we build. This is an opportunity to help shape both the technology and the company as it grows, while building AI systems that genuinely affect player experience.




You will join a team that brings together game development experience, machine learning expertise, and a strong understanding of player-behaviour. Your work will have a direct and measurable effect, influencing how AI agents behave in-game and how those behaviours shape player experience.

We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working at the intersection of data science and software engineering, building machine learning models and turning them into reliable, production-ready systems.




The Role

You will:

Take ownership of machine learning projects from early concepts through production, iteration, and evaluation, with a clear focus on measurable impact
Collaborate closely with software engineers to design, implement, and deploy machine learning systems in production environments using the Unreal Engine
Communicate effectively across disciplines, clearly explaining machine learning concepts, trade-offs, and results to engineers and other technical stakeholders
Work hands-on across the full pipeline, including data exploration, feature engineering, modelling, and software integration
Be comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces and shaping solutions that are still evolving
Bring a pragmatic, curious mindset, with strong motivation to build things that make a real difference

 

Required Background

We would expect you to have one of the following:

A PhD in a machine learning–related field, plus at least 2 years of professional experience outside academia

Or

A Master’s degree in a mathematically intensive or machine learning–focused discipline, plus at least 4 years of hands-on industry experience working with machine learning




In addition, you should have:

Strong programming skills in Python (and/or C++), with experience using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
A solid foundation in machine learning applied in the games industry, statistics, and optimisation techniques
Experience implementing, evaluating, and iterating on machine learning models or algorithms
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills



Nice to Have

We would be excited if you have:

A strong theoretical background combined with practical, production-focused machine learning experience
Familiarity with modern AI model capabilities, limitations, and benchmarking approaches
Having worked in the games industry



Compensation

This is a paid and fully funded position. Compensation will be based on the candidate’s qualifications and experience and can be negotiated during the hiring process. Currently, we are not looking for interns.




Logistics

We believe in the value of meeting in the office, while also having the freedom to work from home from time to time. The position is therefore advertised as “hybrid” and not "remote". We are exclusively looking for candidates who are living in the greater Copenhagen area.




The position is available starting from 1st of September

Title: Quantitative Developer - Python
Description:
Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped our collaborative mindset, which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors.




You will join a quantitative development function that works closely with Researchers, Traders and Cloud Engineering teams to build applications, data pipelines and analytics that support research and trading workflows. The role combines software engineering, quantitative development and data engineering, with responsibility for developing production applications, supporting research infrastructure and integrating large scale datasets.




Your future role within QRT

Design, develop, deploy and maintain cloud native Python applications supporting research and trading workflows, including market data dashboards, risk analytics, profit and loss reporting, weather analytics and performance analysis
Develop quantitative tools including backtesting frameworks, optimisation tools, pricing libraries and ETL pipelines for integrating and validating alternative datasets
Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that support model development and production workflows
Monitor, support, debug and enhance existing research and trading infrastructure
Work closely with Researchers, Traders and Engineering teams to deliver production quality solutions that meet evolving business requirements
Provide support for traders and production trading systems as part of a support model that provides continuous coverage across global markets.




Your present skillset

At least three years of professional Python development experience
Strong knowledge of Python, including numerical libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Polars and Xarray
Strong quantitative mindset with an interest in working closely with trading and research functions
Experience developing user interfaces or an interest in building data visualisation applications such as Plotly, Dash or Streamlit is beneficial
Experience with AWS or another cloud platform together with infrastructure as code technologies (e.g. Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS or AWS CDK is advantageous)
Good knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL together with object storage technologies
Experience developing ETL pipelines and working with large scale datasets
Strong understanding of software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, packaging and deployment
Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver production solutions
Experience with parallel or distributed computing is advantageous




QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.

Title: AI Innovation Specialist - Renewable Energy Solutions

Description:
At Vestas, we are looking for an AI Innovation Specialist who is curious, creative, and passionate about solving real-world challenges. You will collaborate across disciplines, explore emerging AI technologies, and develop solutions that improve how we design, operate, and service renewable energy technologies. Whether your background is in software, data science, robotics, or industrial digitalization, this is your chance to make a lasting impact.

Vestas Technology & Operations > Research & Development (R&D) > Balance of Plant and Service Innovation

At Vestas, the Balance of Plants (BoP) & Service Innovation Department transforms innovative ideas into real solutions that create value for customers and Vestas. We are exploring how AI can help solve real-world challenges across R&D, service and future renewable energy solutions.

We encourage curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning in a supportive environment where new ideas are welcomed, tested, and developed collaboratively.

Title: Trading Quant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job ID: 5317

Are you ready to be part of a team that drives transformation of the trading process - from client inflow to post-trade analysis? We are now looking for a curious Trading Quant that strives for data-driven decision-making, to enhance the measurability of the actions taken by traders and portfolio managers, and to enable our traders to better source liquidity and manage execution risk.

The role is a full time position based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About Our Team

Meet the Trading Quants team. We add value by being change enablers that drive transformation of the investment process as part of an agile value stream where we identify business problems, define and implement solutions, to generate tangible value for our clients.

Our team is part of Nordea Asset Management, Global Trading. Within the investment management area, Global Trading, is responsible for order generation and trade execution on behalf of portfolio managers across asset classes. As a team, we homogenize data across asset classes, add structure and measurability to our investment processes, to unlock scale and quality throughout the organization.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Main responsibilities in this role:


Engage with traders to solve their execution challenges by providing them with data, frameworks, and tools that improve the search for liquidity and highlights execution risks.
Implement AI use cases leveraging our data models.
Drive projects within a value stream, binding together business and technology, to ensure we deliver tangible outcomes for our clients.
Ensure data-driven decision-making by expanding our Trading Data Model and its applications.
Interact with internal and external stakeholders, and our technology providers.
Extract data insights for client services and senior management on an ad-hoc basis.


You’ll join a motivated and experienced quant team that values a cooperative environment where you can draw on your teammates' expertise and commitment to excellence.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you are someone who takes ownership of your work and is driven to make a meaningful impact, while being comfortable sharing your opinions and challenging established ways of thinking. You excel at both analytical and technical problem-solving skills, and have the ability to drive projects forward effectively within virtual team environments. You thrive on learning quickly, are interested in exploring alternative ways of working, and possess strong stakeholder management skills that enable you to build relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.

Your background and skills include:


A solid academic foundation e.g. a masters in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, etc.
Experience with Python and SQL.
An interest in asset management and financial markets.
Fluent in English both verbal and written.


It would be ideal if you also:


Are skilled in building data models using e.g. data build tool (dbt).
Have hands-on experience implementing AI use cases, or a demonstrable enthusiasm for leveraging AI to drive innovation and efficiency.
Have experience with SimCorp Dimension and Snowflake.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 11/09/2026.

For more information, you’re welcome to contact Simon Hørdum Bonde at simon.bonde@nordea.com.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Store Partnering
Place: Albertslund, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Senior Data Scientist – Store Partnering

Coop Danmark, Albertslund (Possibility of remote work)

Do you want to be a key driver in establishing an ambitious new team where decisions are founded in thorough data analysis and where machine learning forecasting methodologies are at the heart of the roadmap? Then this is your opportunity to make your mark on the future of the supply chain at Coop!

Your new team

In the role of Senior Data Scientist you will become a central part of the new Store Partnering team. The team will be heavily focused on spearheading a new approach to data centricity in Coop, and as the team is newly formed, you will be highly able to influence ways of working.

About The Position

As a Senior Data Scientist in Coop’s new Store Partnering team, you will have a central responsibility for establishing and developing the data-driven approach to supply chain processes and decisions. Your focus will be on driving the digital agenda forward in Coop’s supply chain, with the aim of improving the quality and efficiency of planning processes. Focus will be on leveraging the vast data landscape available to a large retail organization - turning data into valuable forecasting and planning action. You will work to make technology, data science and AI a pivotal component in how we do planning to unlock efficiencies in planning processes and improvements to consumer availability for millions of consumers every day.

Your Primary Responsibilities


Tools: Developing promotion of quantity estimation methodologies and related tools. Develop the analytics toolbox that makes campaign and store planning tasks faster to execute.
Data driven culture and problem solving: Drive the agenda of putting analysis, math and statistics behind every decision by supporting the store and demand planning team with advanced analysis for operational decisions and development initiatives.
Measurement & Learning: Help establish the KPI and reporting framework, such that continuous development enables and learnings from campaigns and operations can be reused.
RELEX AI: Driving the ML/AI agenda in Relex and operationalizing relevant large data and AI agent use cases. Includes design, diagnostics, and roadmap development.
Guidance for analysts and specialists: Coaching and sparring with the cohort of analysts and specialists across supply chain planning.


About You

You have solid experience with complex analysis, and you thrive on translating data into concrete improvements. You are analytically strong, structured, and have a natural ability to collaborate across disciplines. You enjoy continuously developing ways of working and are energized about the opportunity to be part of shaping up a new team with a big organizational focus. You are driven by creating structure and momentum in complex deliverables and thrive at the intersection of business, IT, and operations. You can communicate complex statistical and technical concepts and findings for the broader organization.

We imagine that you have several of the following competencies:


4–6 years of experience with applied ML in production environment, preferably within a supply chain or retail context.
Master or PHD within mathematical fields
Strong acumen in data science programming language like Python, R or similar data science programming language and experience with MLOps – model versioning, backtesting, and retraining pipelines
Experienced in feature engineering on demand data, including causal factors such as pricing, promotions, events, and weather
Able to translate complex models into business value and communicate technical results to non-technical stakeholders
Has experience with Relex or similar advanced planning systems


Coop Offers

An exciting role in a highly ambitious environment where you will have the opportunity to make a real difference. You will become part of a dedicated team with a lot of hunger and high professional expertise and strong collaboration, where you help shape the digital agenda in Coop’s supply chain.


Influence on projects that impact our 900 stores and 38,000 colleagues
An attractive compensation package including pension, health insurance, and employee benefits
Discounts in Coop's stores, summer cottage rentals, staff clubs, and purchasing schemes
Flexible working hours and the option of one work-from-home day per week


Your base will be at Coop's head office in Albertslund, close to the teams you collaborate with on a daily basis.

Interested?

Are you ready to help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at one of Scandinavia's largest retailers? Then send your CV via our online application form no later than 03-09-2026. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't hesitate to apply.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Supply Chain Manager Bo Bøgvad by email at bo.boegvad@coop.dk

You can read more about Coop as a workplace at www.coop.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Title: Knowledge Graph Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

About Data & Technology Solutions

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is the WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at scale and at lower cost.

We’re endlessly curious and our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 2,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

What you'll be doing:


Work with development teams to effectively use the existing Knowledge Graph
Translate product and business requirements into graph-based data solutions
Extend and adapt schemas in collaboration with architects when needed

Title: Advanced Analytics Specialist, Supply Chain Intelligence
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about driving high-impact projects in a global supply chain? Do you want to play a key role in delivering transformational initiatives that shape how Ambu scales, operates, and delivers value to patients worldwide?

Ambu is transforming – and this is your opportunity to shape how intelligence drives our supply chain.

We have recently evolved our analytics function into a Supply Chain Intelligence team within our Global Supply Chain organization, and we are seeking an Advanced Analytics Specialist to join us. The team’s ambition is clear: moving from describing what happened to knowing what to do next. You will play a central role in delivering this journey; building predictive and prescriptive models, enabling what-if scenarios and decision support, and strengthening the data foundation that underpins it all; while helping build a data-driven culture across the global supply chain.

At Ambu, we are on an ambitious growth journey - scaling our operations and capabilities to meet the rising global demand for our innovative medical solutions. As part of this journey, you will join a highly motivated team that values initiative, impact, and collaboration; and you will have a front-row seat in maturing how data and intelligence power our global supply chain.

The role

As an Advanced Analytics Specialist, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and deploy analytics solutions that move our global supply chain from descriptive dashboards to predictive and prescriptive intelligence. You will work across our five focus areas: data foundation, reporting & visibility, advanced analytics, decision support, and analytics enablement; with the greatest emphasis on advanced analytics and decision support.

This is a hands-on role where technical depth meets business-centric problem-solving. Working closely with the Advanced Analytics Manager, GSC, you will partner with stakeholders across corporate functions and manufacturing sites – bridging business and IT – to ensure that data becomes a strategic asset embedded in how Ambu’s supply chain makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced analytics & decision support (primary focus)


Develop, deploy, and maintain predictive and prescriptive models (e.g., forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization) that address concrete supply chain challenges across planning, operations, and distribution
Build what-if scenario and simulation capabilities that give leadership actionable decision support; not just reporting
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems, and analytical results into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership
Automate recurring analyses and workflows to free capacity across the organization for higher-value work
Take ownership of solutions end-to-end: from problem framing and data preparation to model deployment in collaboration with back-end IT, monitoring, and adoption


Data foundation, visibility & analytics enablement


Contribute to advancing our data foundation toward a single source of truth; improving data quality, governance, and data models in collaboration with IT
Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and standard GSC reporting where they create genuine visibility and value
Support upskilling across the global supply chain through training, documentation, and self-service enablement; helping embed a data-driven culture
Stay curious about new technologies (AI, machine learning, modern analytics tooling) and proactively bring relevant opportunities into the team


Suggested candidate profile

Skills

Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be described on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have:


2–5 years of experience in analytics, data science, or business intelligence roles. You may have gained your experience in a consultancy, an industrial company, or a data-driven scale-up
Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python (or R) for data preparation, analysis, and modelling
Solid experience with Power BI – including DAX and data modelling – and an eye for visualizations that drive decisions
Experience building predictive models (e.g., forecasting or machine learning) and bringing at least one into real operational use; you know the difference between a notebook and a solution people rely on
Strong business translation skills; you can turn a vague business question into an analytical approach, and an analytical result into a clear recommendation
A working understanding of supply chain processes (e.g., planning, manufacturing, logistics, or distribution); you don't need to be a supply chain expert, but you can speak the language of operations and understand the physical flows behind the data
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills; you build trust quickly and collaborate effectively across functions and levels
A proactive, structured and independent way of working: you thrive in a maturing environment where you help build the way, not just follow it


It is an advantage if you have experience with the following:


Deeper experience within supply chain planning, S&OP, or distribution analytics
ERP data (e.g., Infor), cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Fabric), or optimization and simulation techniques
Experience in integrating new data (e.g., through API/EDI) into database and semantic models
Experience in training or upskilling non-technical colleagues
Exposure to a GxP-regulated industry


Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process at the beginning of August.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About Us

Complir is the AI platform for the product compliance lifecycle, built for retailers, brands, and manufacturers selling physical consumer products across multiple markets.

We believe getting a physical product to market shouldn't mean fighting spreadsheets, PDFs, and supplier emails just to prove it's safe and legal to sell. Product compliance should be continuous, automatic, and understandable, not a bottleneck that slows launches down. We're building the AI infrastructure that makes that possible.

We work with many of the world's largest retailers and brands across fashion, furniture, cosmetics, toys, electronics and many other product categories. We're backed by Y Combinator, and a roster of investors who see what we see: Product compliance is the next major infrastructure category, and we're leading it.

About The Role

Every product you've ever bought, from a kid's toy dinosaur to your electric toothbrush, had to clear a wall of regulation before it reached you. That wall is written down somewhere: scattered across hundreds of government portals, PDFs, and legal databases, in dozens of languages, updated on no schedule anyone agreed to.

Your job is to turn that chaos into structured, queryable data our product can act on. You'll be the person who makes the world's product regulations machine-readable.

The data layer everything stands on

This is not a role where you write Python scripts in isolation. You'll understand, crawl, and monitor regulatory sources across hundreds of jurisdictions, parse raw legal text into a normalized requirement schema, and catch changes the day they land, so every label, Declaration of Conformity, and risk assessment we generate is provably current.

The interesting problems are everywhere: government portals that were last redesigned when fax machines were current, legal text that means different things in different translations, amendments that quietly rewrite three other acts, and the question of how you prove to an enterprise customer that your data was correct on the day they shipped. LLMs make structured extraction over legal text possible for the first time; making it reliable enough to stake a product launch on is the engineering problem you'll own.

You'll do this sitting next to the founders, our AI engineers, and our in-house compliance experts at our Copenhagen HQ. No layers, no ticket queues. When a source breaks or a regulation changes, the fix ships in hours, not sprints.

What You'll Actually Do


Build and operate the crawling and monitoring layer across hundreds of regulatory sources: government portals, legislative databases, and official gazettes in dozens of languages
Parse raw legal text (HTML, PDFs, scans) into a normalized requirement schema, using LLM-assisted extraction pipelines you design, evaluate, and harden
Build change detection that catches new acts, amendments, and repeals the day they land, and triggers the downstream updates our customers depend on
Own data quality end to end: provenance, versioning, and coverage metrics, so every requirement in the platform traces back to its primary source
Work with our regulatory experts to evolve the schema and taxonomy as coverage grows from the EU to new jurisdictions
Shape the architecture, tooling, and data culture as the team grows


You will love this job, if you are:


An engineer with several years building data pipelines, crawling infrastructure, or large-scale extraction systems
Experienced with (or seriously hungry to go deep on) LLM-assisted extraction: structured outputs, evals, and the failure modes of models reading dense text
Someone who treats data correctness as sacred: provenance, versioning, and "how do we know this is still true?" are your favorite questions
Unafraid of messy sources: broken HTML, scanned PDFs, and legal prose in languages you don't speak are puzzles, not blockers
Product-minded: You understand that a quality manager will stake a product launch on your pipeline's output
Bonus points if you have worked with regulatory data before
Comfortable with ambiguity and speed: Small team, fast decisions, no spec handed down from above
Excited to work on-site in Copenhagen with the whole team
A builder at heart


What You Get


Ownership of the regulatory data layer, the foundation the entire product stands on
Zero layers: You sit next to the founders, the AI team, and the compliance experts whose domain you're turning into data
Ground floor of a category-defining company, backed by Y Combinator and investors betting on product compliance becoming the next big thing
Competitive salary and equity
An office where the pastries are mandatory


If you've read this far and thought "that's the data problem I want to own," we'd like to meet you.

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
To Good To Go: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Marketing Personalisation

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Hybrid)

At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste. 

We’re more than an app: we are a certified B Corporation with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste, so alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast: Our community of 127 million registered users and 253,000 active partners across 20 countries, have together already prevented 489+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.322.000 tonnes of CO2e!

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to be a part of our Consumer Growth Product and Tech team that defines, builds, and delivers AI features for our marketing personalization efforts. You will work towards specific outcomes with the freedom and responsibility to figure out the best route to achieve them, collaborating with other engineers, data scientists, and product members. Within the Product & Tech organization, you will work toward generating the smartest possible recommendations for our users. Your work will ensure they are matched with the best meals at the right time, which in turn will result in more meals saved and improved user retention.

Your Mission

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will be part of a team dedicated to delivering a step-change in personalization for our consumer marketplace. You will of course collaborate with your counterparts in other product teams, and will be part of the broader ML and tech communities at Too Good To Go. Your work will directly impact millions of users by improving our surplus food management solutions and personalizing their experience.

Tech Stack

Our models are written in Python, supported by SQL to retrieve data. Our models are built, evaluated, and productionised using our MLOps team's platform, which is based on Metaflow. The full Machine Learning stack includes: GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, Airflow, OpenSearch, and Redshift.

Responsibilities

Working on researching, building, and designing different machine-learning models for marketing personalization.
Running experiments, evaluating, and using the results to improve machine learning models and algorithms.
Working end-to-end to solve problems with a product and customer-oriented mindset.
Building and deploying models in production.
Involvement in developing statistical models.
Collaborating with the rest of the team to improve our product and solve customer problems.

The Ideal Candidate

Has established experience within a similar role.
Experience using Python and deploying to production.
First-hand experience with ML libraries, frameworks, and tools, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Prophet, DeepAR, etc.
Degree educated within a technical field (Computer Science or equivalent engineering degree).
Experience in a cloud environment (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
Bonus: experience with dbt, Snowflake, Airflow, or Metaflow; experience in complex ML system design; and experience in statistical hypothesis testing.

What We Offer

Develop and maintain the backbone of our personalization engine, which is used by millions of users every day to support their efforts to combat food waste.
An opportunity to work in a global social-impact company and certified B Corporation where you can see a real and tangible impact in your role.
To be an integral member of our defined product teams. We are eager for you to make an impact and contribute to the product scope and development; your insights are valuable, and we are here to listen.
We trust in our employees and encourage an autonomous environment that provides several opportunities for employees to contribute, develop, and take ownership of their work in a way that works for them.
To be part of an international company, with over 1,300+ colleagues across 20 countries.

Our values

We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We can do it if we win together as Waste Warriors with no ego. We believe in a #oneteam.
We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers, and elevate one another.
We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.
We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving and want it to last.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Hybrid)

At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste. 

We’re more than an app: we are a certified B Corporation with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste, so alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast: Our community of 127 million registered users and 253,000 active partners across 20 countries, have together already prevented 489+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.322.000 tonnes of CO2e!

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to be a part of our Consumer Growth Product and Tech team that defines, builds, and delivers AI features for our marketing personalization efforts. You will work towards specific outcomes with the freedom and responsibility to figure out the best route to achieve them, collaborating with other engineers, data scientists, and product members. Within the Product & Tech organization, you will work toward generating the smartest possible recommendations for our users. Your work will ensure they are matched with the best meals at the right time, which in turn will result in more meals saved and improved user retention.

Your Mission

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will be part of a team dedicated to delivering a step-change in personalization for our consumer marketplace. You will of course collaborate with your counterparts in other product teams, and will be part of the broader ML and tech communities at Too Good To Go. Your work will directly impact millions of users by improving our surplus food management solutions and personalizing their experience.

Title: Commercial AI & Data Lead - Aurocon
Description:
Kan du omsætte data fra Aurocons intelligente IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder til konkrete produkter, bedre beslutningsgrundlag og nye kommercielle muligheder?




Fra IoT-data til produktudvikling og forretningsmuligheder




Aurocons voksende base af IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder genererer store mængder data om blandt andet hændelser, sensoraktivitet, connectivity, batteri, drift og installationer. Som ansvarlig for AI & Data bringer du disse data i spil.




Stillingen kombinerer strategi med hands-on udvikling, og særligt i starten er du selv den tekniske drivkraft. Du analyserer data, skriver kode, bygger prototyper og dokumenterer, hvor AI og machine learning kan skabe reel kunde- og forretningsværdi.




Dit ansvar omfatter blandt andet at:

kombinere IoT- og tidsseriedata med produktdata, historiske hændelser, supportviden og teknisk dokumentation
skabe struktur, kvalitet og en skalerbar arkitektur omkring virksomhedens datagrundlag
udvikle machine-learning-løsninger til analyse, anomalidetektion, klassifikation og prædiktion
definere og implementere Aurocons AI- og datastrategi
udvikle fundamentet for en modeluafhængig Aurocon AI Engine baseret på egne data og domæneviden
identificere nye AI- og dataprodukter, der øger værdien af Aurotrap-platformen og kan skabe recurring revenue
arbejde hands-on med LLM'er, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, function calling og AI-agenter
udvikle proof-of-concepts og bringe de rigtige løsninger fra prototype til produktion sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet




Du refererer direkte til CEO, arbejder tæt sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet og kommunikerer med både kunder og kommercielle samarbejdspartnere. CTO har ansvaret for hardware, embedded software, firmware og den tekniske produktplatform, mens du får ejerskab for data, analytics, machine learning og AI.




Teknisk builder med blik for produkt og forretning




Du er enten Head of AI i dag eller er klar til dit næste karriereskridt fra din nuværende position som AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI Lead eller tilsvarende. Det afgørende er din tekniske tyngde, evne til selv at bygge løsninger og din ambition om med tiden at tage et strategisk og ledelsesmæssigt ansvar.




Du har solid erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

Data Science, Machine Learning og generativ AI
Python, SQL, data engineering og større datamængder
LLM-arkitektur, RAG, embeddings og vector databases
function calling og AI-agenter
API-integrationer, model deployment og MLOps/LLMOps
cloud-, data- og analyticsarkitektur.




Kendskab til f.eks. Qwen, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face eller vLLM er relevant. Du er ikke bundet til én teknologistak, men har en pragmatisk tilgang til teknologi og vurderer modeller og løsninger ud fra kvalitet, økonomi, latency, sikkerhed, GDPR, skalerbarhed og den konkrete forretningsværdi.




Derudover har du erfaring med IoT, tidsseriedata, hardware-enabled software og operationelle eventdata.




Du er analytisk stærk, nysgerrig og selvkørende og trives med opgaver, hvor løsningen ikke er defineret på forhånd.




Din tekniske faglighed kombinerer du med et produkt- og forretningsorienteret mindset, der gør dig i stand til at prioritere muligheder ud fra kundeværdi, betalingsvillighed, differentiering, udviklingsomkostninger og skalerbarhed.




En spændende karrieremulighed




Du får en sjælden mulighed for at bygge et strategisk vigtigt område fra bunden. Aurocon har allerede de fysiske produkter, en international installeret base og et voksende datasæt fra enheder i virkelige miljøer. Ambitionen er, at data og AI bliver en central del af virksomhedens næste produktgeneration og langsigtede konkurrenceevne.




I takt med at området vokser, får du mulighed for at opbygge og lede et AI- og datateam. For den rette profil kan stillingen derfor blive et markant karriereskridt fra teknisk specialist til leder med et bredere strategisk teknologiansvar.




Om Aurocon




Auroconudvikler og producerer avancerede løsninger til skadedyrsbekæmpelse baseret på banebrydende teknologi.




Flagskibsproduktet The Aurotrap med tilhørende IT platform og mobil app, er en IoT baseret intelligent, giftfri multi-kill rottefælde, som gør det muligt at overvåge og håndtere rotteaktivitet i realtid.




Fra hovedsædet i Aalborg opererer Aurocon.io på internationale markeder og leverer løsninger, der forbedrer både operationel effektivitet og miljømæssig bæredygtighed.

Title: Quantitative Researcher - Equity Statistical Arbitrage
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Imagine working with cutting-edge machine learning models, crunching high frequency data sets and sparring with exceptional and fun colleagues, all while taking part in scaling our business even further.




Does this sound highly appealing to you? Then you might be our new Senior Quantitative Researcher in the Equity Statistical Arbitrage wing of Alipes Capital!




This position is focused on

Elevating our predictive modeling standards to the highest levels in the area of statistical arbitrage of traded funds.
Creating a world class modeling workflow, enabling the team to turn massive data sets of financial information into mathematical models that accurately predict movements in the markets.
In particular, the fixed-income section of our traded universe, in which we believe there is a significant untapped signal.




In doing so, you will get a chance to tackle a variety of software infrastructure challenges, such as:

Development and optimization of calibration and benchmarking frameworks.
Building out and implementing best practices for data preparation and dataset generation pipelines.
Prototyping and releasing novel predictive architectures, especially with respect to time-series models.




You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult. It is pure play.




About you

Fluency within mathematics and statistics.
Experience working with financial data, in particular valuation and hedging of fixed-income instruments.
Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack from data generation through model calibration and real-life validation and monitoring.
Programming experience with Python, in particular data-wrangling and numerical programming.
Proficiency with computer science fundamentals.
A scientific and inquisitive mind.




Nice to have

Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.
Programming experience with languages like C# and C/C++.
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, physics, computer science, mathematics or economics.




About the team

At Alipes Capital, we have been a market leader in equity and electricity algorithmic trading since starting in 2008. We maintain an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done.




The Quant team consists of eighteen passionate quantitative researchers covering 6 nationalities, with thirteen PhD’s and five MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. The stat-arb sub-team is a tight group of 3 researchers.




We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We work alongside a team of software engineers and a team of traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. All team members across the organization write code and drive change and are equally willing to engage on a nitty-gritty technical level as well as discuss the larger strategic level.




What we can offer you

Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.
A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.




Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV and a cover letter telling us why you think this role is a great fit for you. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.

Title: Quantitative Developer
Description:
About the Opportunity:




Koda Staff is partnering with a leading systematic investment manager that combines technology, quantitative research and data science to build sophisticated trading strategies across global financial markets.




This is an opportunity to join a highly collaborative quantitative engineering team working alongside Researchers, Traders and Cloud Engineers to develop the technology that powers research, analytics and live trading. The environment is fast-paced, highly technical and focused on solving complex problems through engineering excellence and data-driven decision making.

If you're passionate about Python, quantitative development and building scalable data platforms, this could be an excellent next step in your career.




The Role:

As a Python Quantitative Developer, you'll play a key role in designing and developing production-grade applications and research infrastructure that directly supports quantitative research and trading activities.




Working closely with researchers and trading teams, you'll build scalable software, quantitative tools and cloud-native data platforms that enable better investment decisions.




Responsibilities:

Design, develop and maintain cloud-native Python applications supporting quantitative research and trading workflows.




Build applications including:

Market data dashboards
Risk analytics
Profit & Loss reporting
Weather analytics
Performance analysis tools
Develop quantitative tooling, including:
Backtesting frameworks
Optimisation libraries
Pricing libraries
ETL pipelines
Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for both research and production environments.
Integrate, validate and process large alternative datasets
Monitor, troubleshoot and continuously improve existing research and trading infrastructure.
Collaborate closely with Quantitative Researchers, Traders and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality production software.




What We're Looking For:




3+ years of commercial Python development experience.
Strong knowledge of Python and numerical computing libraries, including:
NumPy, Pandas, Polars, Xarray
A strong quantitative mindset with an interest in financial markets and systematic trading.
Experience building scalable production software.
Experience developing ETL pipelines and processing large datasets.
Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including:
Git, Automated testing, Packaging, CI/CD and deployment
Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
Knowledge of object storage technologies.#
Comfortable working independently while collaborating with both technical and business stakeholders.




If you are located in Aarhus and this sounds like you, please apply directly.

Du samarbejder direkte med kunden, afklarer tekniske behov og skaber fremdrift i leverancen. Det afgørende er, at du både kan bygge løsningerne selv, sætte teknisk retning og løfte kvaliteten omkring dig.




Du bliver en del af et større fagligt miljø i vores AI, Apps & Automation-capability. Her arbejder du tæt sammen med data scientists samt software- og automationsspecialister og samarbejder på tværs af capabilities med data engineers, arkitekter, forretningskonsulenter m.fl.




Om rollen

Som Senior Data Scientist leder du det tekniske arbejde og er samtidig selv en aktiv del af udførelsen. Du arbejder hands-on med kode, modeller, eksperimenter, løsningsdesign og produktionsmodning.

Du tager ansvar for de svære tekniske valg og hjælper teamet med at fastholde kvalitet og fremdrift.




Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Lede tekniske AI- og machine learning-projekter fra problemforståelse til produktionsklar løsning
Omsætte uklare forretningsbehov til konkrete tekniske problemstillinger og løsningsdesign
Sætte teknisk retning og træffe valg om modeller, metoder, arkitektur og platforme
Drive tekniske afklaringer med relevante stakeholders hos kunden
Sikre sammenhæng mellem teknisk kvalitet, anvendelighed, governance og forretningsværdi
Bidrage til scoping, estimering og kvalificering af nye kundeopgaver
Mentorere kolleger og udvikle genanvendelige metoder, komponenter og accelerators




Afhængigt af din specialisering kan du eksempelvis arbejde med forecasting, optimering, recommendation engines og MLOps eller med RAG, dokumentintelligens, copilots, agentic AI og intelligente workflows.




Sådan skaber du succes i rollen

Du omsætter komplekse AI- og machine learning-problemstillinger til løsninger med tydelig forretningsværdi
Du skaber struktur og fremdrift, også når rammerne eller løsningen ikke er givet på forhånd
Du bygger løsninger, der kan implementeres, anvendes, monitoreres og videreudvikles
Du skaber tillid gennem faglig tyngde, tydelig kommunikation og kvalificerede tekniske anbefalinger
Du løfter kvaliteten omkring dig gennem sparring, mentoring og genanvendelige metoder




Din profil

Konsulenterfaring er et krav.

Du har erfaring fra et konsulenthus, hvor du har arbejdet direkte med kunder og taget ansvar for komplekse data science-, machine learning- eller AI-leverancer.




Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

Har haft en ledende teknisk rolle eller taget tydeligt ansvar i komplekse kundeprojekter
Har udviklet og implementeret produktionsorienterede løsninger inden for machine learning og/eller generativ AI
Har stærke kompetencer i Python, kan arbejde sikkert med SQL og har forståelse for moderne software engineering
Har erfaring med Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric eller tilsvarende cloudplatforme
Forstår deployment, test, CI/CD, monitorering, governance og driftsoverdragelse
Kan omsætte forretningsbehov til tekniske løsninger og kommunikere valg, risici og trade-offs til kunden
Har erfaring med at sparre med kolleger og gerne bidraget til scoping, estimering eller genanvendelige løsninger




Du behøver ikke være ekspert i både machine learning og generativ AI. Det afgørende er, at du har dokumenteret dybde inden for mindst ét område og kan samarbejde troværdigt med andre specialister om den samlede løsning.




Det tilbyder vi

Hos Inspari bliver du en del af et ambitiøst konsulenthus med stærk specialisering inden for data og AI og komplekse opgaver hos enterprise-kunder.

Du får blandt andet:

Ansvar for komplekse AI- og machine learning-leverancer med synlig kundeværdi
Mulighed for at sætte teknisk retning og påvirke, hvordan vi udvikler vores AI-løsninger
Et stærkt fagligt miljø på tværs af data science, software, automation og Data Platform
Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og videre specialisering
Fleksible arbejdsforhold og mulighed for hybridarbejde
En kultur præget af høj faglighed, ansvar, samarbejde og Heartwork




Lokation

Du vil være tilknyttet vores kontor i Lystrup ved Aarhus eller Kgs. Lyngby. Arbejdet foregår i en hybrid model mellem kontoret, kunderne og hjemmearbejdspladsen.




Rejseaktivitet

Som konsulent må du forvente en vis rejseaktivitet. Omfanget afhænger af projekterne og planlægges løbende i samarbejde med dig.




Ansøg

Hvis rollen matcher din erfaring, faglige profil og det ansvar, du ønsker fremover, glæder vi os til at modtage dit CV og din ansøgning.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet det rette match. Forventet opstart er den 1. oktober 2026.




Har du spørgsmål til rollen eller processen, kan du kontakte Talent Acquisition Director Steffen Krogsgaard på krog@inspari.dk.

Title: Lead Analytics Platform Developer
Place: Gentofte, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join us in this role where you’ll be the Business Application Responsible for the Analytics Workspace, a JupyterHub-based platform built on cloud Kubernetes and used across Trading & Revenue. You’ll co-develop the platform with Commercial Digital Technology, guide and test deliveries, and make sure the platform evolves in line with user needs across analytics, algo development, and model development.

Welcome to Analytics

You’ll be part of Data Science & Platforms, one of three teams in Trading & Revenue’s Analytics function, where you, together with your colleagues, will deliver the platforms and products behind trading and revenue decisions. You’ll work closely with quantitative developers, analysts, model developers, and Commercial Digital Technology to shape a reliable, scalable platform that supports both current users and new analytics capabilities. As a team, we value flexibility, experimentation, knowledge sharing, and collaboration. We care about building an inclusive environment where different perspectives help us create better solutions.

You’ll play an important role in:


owning the Analytics Workspace on the Trading & Revenue side, ensuring it remains reliable, relevant, and well aligned with business needs
co-developing platform capabilities with Commercial Digital Technology through coding, prototyping, reviewing pull requests, and defining acceptance tests
enabling strong platform foundations for analytics, algo development, and machine learning use cases, including compute, environments, data access, deployment, logging, and monitoring
supporting users through onboarding, day-to-day platform support, and close collaboration with stakeholders across Trading & Revenue
maintaining best practices, tools, templates, and ways of working for analytics engineering and the wider analytics community
driving the platform roadmap, including improvements, migrations, and adjacent capabilities such as machine learning, streaming and AI tooling.


To succeed in the role, you:


have strong Python development skills and apply sound engineering practices across testing, packaging, and CI/CD
bring hands-on experience with JupyterHub-based platforms, Kubernetes, Airflow and cloud infrastructure in Azure, AWS, or similar environments
work confidently across DevOps or MLOps topics and can contribute to platform design, delivery, and operational excellence
collaborate well with internal users and external engineering partners, and communicate clearly with both technical and business stakeholders
take ownership, build trust, and stay close to user needs while helping specialist teams contribute and co-own solutions
are motivated to grow your understanding of Trading & Revenue analytics, and you bring curiosity, structure, and a practical mindset to complex platform challenges.


Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range:

For this position, the expected base pay range is kr58,000.00- kr87,000.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our benefits package:

For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

Pre-employment background check:

Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Title: Data Engineer – Cost Index Optimization
Place: Odense, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Engineering | Odense, Denmark | Full-Time

Jeppesen ForeFlight builds software that airlines and pilots around the world rely on every day. From our Odense office, you'll join an international engineering organization where your work has a direct, measurable impact on airline fuel efficiency and emissions.

Own the data platform behind a new flight optimization engine

We're hiring a Data Engineer for a new team building our next-generation Cost Index Optimization (CIO) product. Decoded flight recorder (QAR) data arrives from upstream providers — everything after that is yours: the lakehouse, data quality, per-tail training datasets, and the savings reporting our airline customers see.

What You'll Do


Build the data lakehouse (Iceberg/S3, Bronze/Silver/Gold layers) for flight data at fleet scale
Own data quality at the ingestion boundary — automated validation of inbound QAR data, including duplicate detection, date/route checks, and cross-checks against independent sources like ADS-B
Build per-tail training and validation datasets and the feature engineering layer for the modeling team
Build the savings reporting framework that quantifies fuel and cost savings per customer fleet
Support large-scale reprocessing as models, parsers, and quality rules evolve



What We're Looking For


Strong data engineering experience with Python, SQL, and a modern lakehouse or warehouse stack (Iceberg, Delta, or similar) in production
Experience running pipelines on AWS (S3, batch processing/orchestration, infrastructure as code)
A data-quality mindset — you treat validation as a product feature, not an afterthought
Comfort working with large volumes of noisy sensor or time-series data
Interest in aviation is a plus; domain expertise is not required



Why Join Jeppesen ForeFlight?

We believe a rewarding career is built on meaningful challenges, a supportive environment, and great colleagues. At Jeppesen ForeFlight, we empower our employees to make a direct impact on our products and services while supporting their overall wellbeing.

Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance, a pension plan, generous paid vacation plus additional time off during Christmas, a health and wellness allowance, an employee assistance program, two paid volunteer days annually, an employee referral program, and flight rewards and a flight stipend.
